name: zero_pseudoOf
statement: theorem zero_pseudoOf : (0 : MvPolynomial σ R).pseudoOf i f = ⟨1 - f.degreeOf i, 0, 0⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [pseudoOf]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [h]
  rw [pseudoOf.go, degreeOf_zero, zero_add]
  have : 1 - f.degreeOf i = 0 := Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h)
  simp only [Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h, this, ↓reduceIte]

name: pseudoOf_self
statement: theorem pseudoOf_self : f.pseudoOf i f = ⟨1, f.initialOf i, 0⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [pseudoOf]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [initialOf_eq_of_degreeOf_eq_zero h]
  simp [pseudoOf.go, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h]

name: pseudoOfGo_next
proof:

name: pseudoOfGo_equation
statement:
lemma pseudoOfGo_equation (h : f.degreeOf i ≠ 0) (s : ℕ) (q r : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    f.initialOf i ^ s * g = q * f + r → letI result
proof:
:= pseudoOf.go i f s q r h;
    f.initialOf i ^ result.exponent * g = result.quotient * f + result.remainder := by
  induction s, q, r using pseudoOf.go.induct i f h with
  | case1 s q r dlt => rw [pseudoOf.go]; simp only [dlt, ↓reduceIte, imp_self]
  | case2 s q r dlt term I q' r' ih =>
    intro heq
    suffices I ^ (s + 1) * g = q' * f + r' by
      rw [pseudoOfGo_next i f h s q (le_of_not_gt dlt), ih this]
    unfold q' r'
    have : (I * q + term) * f + (I * r - term * f) = I * (q * f + r) + (term - term) * f :=
      by ring
    nth_rw 1 [this, ← heq]
    ring

name: pseudoOf_equation
statement:
theorem pseudoOf_equation : f.initialOf i ^ (g.pseudoOf i f).exponent * g
    = (g.pseudoOf i f).quotient * f + (g.pseudoOf i f).remainder
proof:
:= by
  rw [pseudoOf]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [pow_one, add_zero, initialOf_eq_of_degreeOf_eq_zero h, mul_comm]
  exact g.pseudoOfGo_equation _ _ _ _ _ _ (by ring)

name: degreeOf_pseudoOfGo_remainder_le_of_degreeOf_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  induction s, q, r using pseudoOf.go.induct i f h with
  | case1 s q r h => rw [pseudoOf.go]; simp only [h, ↓reduceIte, Std.le_refl]
  | case2 s q r dlt term I q' r' ih =>
    apply le_trans (pseudoOfGo_next i f h s q (le_of_not_gt dlt) ▸ ih)
    apply le_trans (degreeOf_sub_le ..)
    apply max_le <;> apply le_trans (degreeOf_mul_le ..)
    · have Id : I.degreeOf j = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero <| hj ▸ degreeOf_initialOf_le i j f
      simp only [Id, zero_add, le_refl]
    simp only [hj, add_zero, term]
    apply le_trans (degreeOf_mul_le ..)
    rw [degreeOf_X_pow_of_ne _ hi.symm, add_zero]
    exact degreeOf_initialOf_le i j r

name: degreeOf_pseudoOf_remainder_le_of_degreeOf_eq_zero
statement:
theorem degreeOf_pseudoOf_remainder_le_of_degreeOf_eq_zero {i j : σ} (g : MvPolynomial σ R)
    {f : MvPolynomial σ R} (hi : i ≠ j) (hj : f.degreeOf j = 0) :
    (g.pseudoOf i f).remainder.degreeOf j ≤ g.degreeOf j
proof:
:= by
  rw [pseudoOf]
  split_ifs with h
  · exact (@degreeOf_zero R _ _ _) ▸ Nat.zero_le _
  exact degreeOf_pseudoOfGo_remainder_le_of_degreeOf_eq_zero h hi hj ..

name: dvd_pseudoOf_remainder_of_dvd
statement:
theorem dvd_pseudoOf_remainder_of_dvd (i : σ) {g f : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : f ∣ g) :
    f ∣ (g.pseudoOf i f).remainder
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨c, hc⟩
  have heq := g.pseudoOf_equation i f
  set res := g.pseudoOf i f
  rw [hc, mul_comm, mul_assoc, mul_comm _ f] at heq
  exact (dvd_add_right ⟨_, rfl⟩).mp (heq ▸ (⟨_, rfl⟩ : f ∣ f * (c * _ ^ _)))

name: pseudoOf_remainder_eq_of_degreeOf_eq_zero
statement:
theorem pseudoOf_remainder_eq_of_degreeOf_eq_zero {i : σ} {g f : MvPolynomial σ R}
    (h1 : g.degreeOf i = 0) (h2 : f.degreeOf i ≠ 0) : (g.pseudoOf i f).remainder = g
proof:
:= by
  have : g.pseudoOf i f = pseudoOf.go i f 0 0 g h2 := by simp only [pseudoOf, h2, ↓reduceDIte]
  rw [this, pseudoOf.go, h1, if_pos (Nat.ne_zero_iff_zero_lt.mp h2)]

name: degreeOf_pseudoOfGo_remainder_lt_of_degreeOf_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  induction s, q, r using pseudoOf.go.induct i f h with
  | case1 s q r h => rw [pseudoOf.go]; simp only [h, ↓reduceIte]
  | case2 s q r dlt term I q' r' ih =>
    refine lt_of_eq_of_lt ?_ ih
    rw [pseudoOfGo_next _ _ h _ _ (Nat.not_lt.mp dlt)]

name: degreeOf_pseudoOf_remainder_lt_of_degreeOf_ne_zero
statement:
theorem degreeOf_pseudoOf_remainder_lt_of_degreeOf_ne_zero {i : σ} (g : MvPolynomial σ R)
    {f : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : f.degreeOf i ≠ 0) :
    (g.pseudoOf i f).remainder.degreeOf i < f.degreeOf i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pseudoOf, h, ↓reduceDIte]
  exact degreeOf_pseudoOfGo_remainder_lt_of_degreeOf_ne_zero h 0 0 g

name: pseudoOf_remainder_eq_zero_of_dvd
statement:
theorem pseudoOf_remainder_eq_zero_of_dvd {i : σ} {g f : MvPolynomial σ R} (h1 : f ∣ g)
    (h2 : f.degreeOf i ≠ 0) : (g.pseudoOf i f).remainder = 0
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨c, hc⟩ : f ∣ (g.pseudoOf i f).remainder := dvd_pseudoOf_remainder_of_dvd i h1
  set r := (g.pseudoOf i f).remainder
  by_contra con
  absurd degreeOf_pseudoOf_remainder_lt_of_degreeOf_ne_zero g h2
  have : r.degreeOf i = f.degreeOf i + c.degreeOf i :=
    hc ▸ degreeOf_mul_eq (left_ne_zero_of_mul (hc ▸ con)) (right_ne_zero_of_mul (hc ▸ con))
  rw [not_lt, this]
  exact Nat.le_add_right _ _

name: pseudoOf_remainder_reducedTo
statement:
theorem pseudoOf_remainder_reducedTo {c : σ} (g : MvPolynomial σ R) {f : MvPolynomial σ R}
    (hc : f.vars.max = c) : (g.pseudoOf c f).remainder.reducedTo f
proof:
:= by
  have : f.degreeOf c ≠ 0 := degreeOf_max_vars_ne_zero hc
  by_cases r_zero : (g.pseudoOf c f).remainder = 0
  · simp only [r_zero, reducedTo, ↓reduceIte]
  apply (reducedTo_iff hc r_zero).mpr
  exact degreeOf_pseudoOf_remainder_lt_of_degreeOf_ne_zero g this

name: isRemainder_def
statement:
theorem isRemainder_def (r g f : MvPolynomial σ R) : r.IsRemainder g f ↔
    r.reducedTo f ∧ ∃ (s : ℕ) (q : MvPolynomial σ R), f.initial ^ s * g = q * f + r
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: isSetRemainder_def
statement:
theorem isSetRemainder_def (r g : MvPolynomial σ R) (S : TriangularSet σ R) :
    r.IsSetRemainder g S ↔ r.reducedToSet S ∧ ∃ (es : List ℕ) (qs : List (MvPolynomial σ R)),
      (es.length = S.length ∧ qs.length = S.length) ∧
      (∏ i : Fin es.length, (S i).initial ^ es[i]) * g = (∑ i : Fin qs.length, qs[i] * S i) + r
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: pseudo_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem pseudo_zero {g : MvPolynomial σ R} : g.pseudo 0 = ⟨0, 0, g⟩
proof:
:= by

name: pseudo_C
statement:
@[simp] theorem pseudo_C {g : MvPolynomial σ R} {r : R} (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    g.pseudo (C r) = ⟨0, r⁻¹ • g, 0⟩
proof:

name: zero_pseudo
statement: @[simp] theorem zero_pseudo : (0 : MvPolynomial σ R).pseudo f = ⟨0, 0, 0⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pseudo, smul_zero, zero_pseudoOf, ite_eq_left_iff]
  intro _
  match hc : f.vars.max with
  | ⊥ => simp only
  | some c =>
    simp only [PseudoResult.mk.injEq, and_self, and_true]
    rw [Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero <| degreeOf_max_vars_ne_zero hc)]

name: pseudo_remainder_self
statement: @[simp] theorem pseudo_remainder_self : (f.pseudo f).remainder = 0
proof:
:= by

  split_ifs with h
  · rw [h]

name: pseudo_of_max_vars_isSome
statement:
theorem pseudo_of_max_vars_isSome {c : σ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    f.vars.max = c → g.pseudo f = g.pseudoOf c f
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  have : f ≠ 0 := fun hf ↦ absurd (h ▸ WithBot.coe_ne_bot) (by simp [hf])
  simp only [pseudo, this, h, reduceIte]

name: pseudo_equation
statement:
theorem pseudo_equation :
    f.initial ^ (g.pseudo f).exponent * g = (g.pseudo f).quotient * f + (g.pseudo f).remainder
proof:
:= by
  unfold pseudo
  split_ifs with f_zero
  · rw [pow_zero, one_mul, zero_mul, zero_add]
  match hc : f.vars.max with
  | ⊥ =>
    have hf_C : f = C (f.coeff 0) := vars_eq_empty_iff_eq_C.mp <| Finset.max_eq_bot.mp hc
    simp only [pow_zero, one_mul, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, add_zero]
    nth_rw 2 [hf_C]
    have : f.coeff 0 ≠ 0 := C_ne_zero.mp <| hf_C ▸ f_zero
    rw [mul_comm, ← smul_eq_C_mul, ← mul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ this, one_smul]
  | some c => simp only [initial_of_max_vars_isSome' hc]; exact g.pseudoOf_equation c f

name: degreeOf_pseudo_remainder_le_of_degreeOf_eq_zero
statement:
theorem degreeOf_pseudo_remainder_le_of_degreeOf_eq_zero {i : σ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R}
    (h : f.degreeOf i = 0) : (g.pseudo f).remainder.degreeOf i ≤ g.degreeOf i
proof:
:= by
  unfold pseudo
  split_ifs with f_zero
  · exact Nat.le_refl _
  match hc : f.vars.max with
  | ⊥ => simp only [degreeOf_zero, zero_le]
  | some c =>
    have : c ≠ i := by contrapose! h; exact degreeOf_max_vars_ne_zero <| h ▸ hc
    exact degreeOf_pseudoOf_remainder_le_of_degreeOf_eq_zero g this h

proof:

  match h : f.vars.max with
  | ⊥ => simp only; trivial
  | some c => exact g.pseudoOf_remainder_reducedTo h

statement:
theorem pseudo_remainder_eq_zero_of_dvd {g f : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : f ∣ g) :

theorem pseudo_remainder_eq_of_degreeOf_eq_zero {g f : MvPolynomial σ R} {c : σ}

name: length_setPseudoGo
statement:
lemma length_setPseudoGo (f : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R) (fuel : ℕ) : ∀ (es : List ℕ) (qs) (r),
    (setPseudo.go f fuel es qs r).exponents.length = es.length + fuel ∧
    (setPseudo.go f fuel es qs r).quotients.length = qs.length + fuel
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel with
  | zero => simp only [setPseudo.go, ↓reduceIte, add_zero, and_self, implies_true]
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro eq qs r
    unfold setPseudo.go
    simp only [Nat.add_eq_zero_iff, one_ne_zero, and_false, ↓reduceIte, add_tsub_cancel_right]
    simp only [(ih ..).1, (ih ..).2, length_cons, length_map]
    exact ⟨by ring, by ring⟩

name: length_setPseudo_exponents
statement: theorem length_setPseudo_exponents : (g.setPseudo S).exponents.length = S.length
proof:
:= by
  rw [setPseudo, (length_setPseudoGo ..).1, length_nil, zero_add]

name: length_setPseudo_quotients
statement: theorem length_setPseudo_quotients : (g.setPseudo S).quotients.length = S.length
proof:
:= by
  rw [setPseudo, (length_setPseudoGo ..).2, length_nil, zero_add]

name: setPseudoGo_equation
statement:
lemma setPseudoGo_equation (f : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R) (fuel : ℕ) : ∀ (es : List ℕ) (qs) (r),
    es.foldrIdx (fun i e I ↦ (f i).initial ^ e * I) 1 fuel * g =
      qs.foldrIdx (fun i q Q ↦ q * f i + Q) 0 fuel + r →
    letI result
proof:
:= setPseudo.go f fuel es qs r;
    result.exponents.foldrIdx (fun i e I ↦ (f i).initial ^ e * I) 1 * g =
      result.quotients.foldrIdx (fun i q Q ↦ q * f i + Q) 0 + result.remainder := by
  induction fuel with
  | zero => simp only [setPseudo.go, ↓reduceIte, imp_self, implies_true]
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro es qs r heq
    let p := r.pseudo (f fuel)
    let es' := p.exponent :: es
    let qs' := p.quotient :: qs.map (· * (f fuel).initial ^ p.exponent)
    let r' := p.remainder
    have hp : (f fuel).initial ^ p.exponent * r = p.quotient * f fuel + p.remainder :=
      r.pseudo_equation (f fuel)
    have : setPseudo.go f (fuel + 1) es qs r = setPseudo.go f fuel es' qs' r' := by
      rw [setPseudo.go]; simp; rfl
    have heq' : es'.foldrIdx (fun i e I ↦ (f i).initial ^ e * I) 1 fuel * g =
        qs'.foldrIdx (fun i q Q ↦ q * f i + Q) 0 fuel + r' := by
      unfold es' qs' r'
      simp only [foldrIdx]
      have (n : ℕ) (r : MvPolynomial σ R) (qs : List (MvPolynomial σ R)) :
          r * qs.foldrIdx (fun i q Q ↦ q * f i + Q) 0 n
            = (qs.map (fun q ↦ q * r)).foldrIdx (fun i q Q ↦ q * f i + Q) 0 n := by
        induction qs generalizing n with
        | nil => simp only [foldrIdx, mul_zero, map_nil]
        | cons q qs hq =>
          simp only [foldrIdx, map_cons, foldrIdx_cons]
          rw [mul_add, hq (n + 1), mul_comm q r, mul_assoc]
      rw [mul_assoc, heq, mul_add, hp, ← this]
      ring
    rw [this, ih es' qs' r' heq']

name: setPseudo_equation'
statement: theorem setPseudo_equation' : letI result
proof:
:= g.setPseudo S
    result.exponents.foldrIdx (fun i e I ↦ (S i).initial ^ e * I) 1 * g
      = result.quotients.foldrIdx (fun i q Q ↦ q * S i + Q) 0 + result.remainder :=
  g.setPseudoGo_equation _ _ _ _ _ (by simp only [foldrIdx, one_mul, zero_add])

name: setPseudo_equation
statement: theorem setPseudo_equation : letI result
proof:
:= g.setPseudo S
    (∏ i : Fin result.exponents.length, (S i).initial ^ result.exponents[i]) * g
    = (∑ i : Fin result.quotients.length, result.quotients[i] * S i) + result.remainder := by
  have hes (es : List ℕ) (S : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R) : es.foldrIdx (fun i e I ↦ (S i) ^ e * I) 1
      = (∏ i ∈ Finset.range es.length, (S i) ^ es.getD i 0) := by
    induction es generalizing S with
    | nil => simp
    | cons e es ih =>
      simp only [foldrIdx, zero_add, length_cons]
      rw [foldrIdx_start, ih, add_comm _ 1, Finset.prod_range_add, Finset.prod_range_one]
      simp [add_comm]
  have hqs (qs : List (MvPolynomial σ R)) (S : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R) :
      qs.foldrIdx (fun i q Q ↦ q * S i + Q) 0
        = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range qs.length, qs.getD i 0 * S i) := by
    induction qs generalizing S with
    | nil => simp
    | cons q qs ih =>
      simp only [foldrIdx, zero_add, length_cons]
      rw [foldrIdx_start, ih, add_comm _ 1, Finset.sum_range_add, Finset.sum_range_one]
      simp [add_comm]
  simpa [hes, hqs, Finset.prod_range, Finset.sum_range] using g.setPseudo_equation' S

name: zero_setPseudoRem
statement:
theorem zero_setPseudoRem (l : List (MvPolynomial σ R)) :
    l.foldr (fun p r : MvPolynomial σ R ↦ (r.pseudo p).remainder) 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp only [foldr_nil]
  | cons a l ih => simp only [foldr_cons, ih, zero_pseudo]

name: setPseudoGo_drop_succ_remainder_eq
statement:
lemma setPseudoGo_drop_succ_remainder_eq {k n : ℕ} (hn : n < k) (hk : k ≤ S.length) : ∀ es qs r,
    (setPseudo.go (S.drop (k - (n + 1))) (n + 1) es qs r).remainder =
    ((setPseudo.go (S.drop (k - n)) n es qs r).remainder.pseudo (S (k - (n + 1)))).remainder
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing k with
  | zero => simp [setPseudo.go]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro es qs r
    have ih := ih (Nat.lt_sub_of_add_lt hn) (le_trans (Nat.sub_le k 1) hk)
    rw [Nat.Simproc.sub_add_eq_comm k (n + 1) 1, setPseudo.go]
    nth_rw 2 [setPseudo.go]
    simp only [Nat.add_eq_zero_iff, one_ne_zero, and_false, and_self, ↓reduceIte,
      add_tsub_cancel_right, drop_apply, ih]
    have : k - 1 - (n + 1) + (n + 1) = (k - (n + 1)) + n := by grind
    rw [this, Nat.Simproc.sub_add_eq_comm]

name: setPseudo_remainder_eq_setPseudoRem
statement: theorem setPseudo_remainder_eq_setPseudoRem : (g.setPseudo S).remainder = g.setPseudoRem S
proof:
:= by
  unfold setPseudo setPseudoRem
  induction h : S.length generalizing S with
  | zero => simp [setPseudo.go, List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (h ▸ length_toList S)]
  | succ n ih =>
    have := setPseudoGo_drop_succ_remainder_eq S (lt_add_one n) (h ▸ le_refl _) ([]) ([]) g
    simp only [tsub_self, TriangularSet.drop_zero, add_tsub_cancel_left] at this
    rw [this, ih _ (by simp [h, add_tsub_cancel_right]), toList_drop, drop_one]
    have h : S.toList ≠ [] := length_pos_iff.mp (length_toList S ▸ h ▸ Nat.zero_lt_succ n)
    rw [← cons_head_tail h, foldr_cons, cons_head_tail, head_eq_getElem_zero, toList_getElem]

name: setPseudoRem_reducedTo
statement:
lemma setPseudoRem_reducedTo (l : List (MvPolynomial σ R)) (hl1 : ∀ ⦃p⦄, p ∈ l → p ≠ 0)
    (hl2 : l.Pairwise fun p q ↦ p.vars.max < q.vars.max) : ∀ g p : MvPolynomial σ R, p ∈ l →
    (l.foldr (fun p r ↦ (r.pseudo p).remainder) g).reducedTo p
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp only [not_mem_nil, foldr_nil, IsEmpty.forall_iff, implies_true]
  | cons a l ih =>
    intro g p hp
    rw [foldr_cons]
    rcases eq_or_mem_of_mem_cons hp with hp | hp
    · exact hp.symm ▸ pseudo_remainder_reducedTo _ a (hl1 mem_cons_self)
    have ih := ih (fun p hp ↦ hl1 <| mem_cons_of_mem _ hp) (pairwise_cons.mp hl2).2 g p hp
    set r' := l.foldr (fun p r ↦ (r.pseudo p).remainder) g
    rw [reducedTo] at ih ⊢
    split_ifs with hr'
    have r'_ne_zero : r' ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ by absurd hr'; simp only [h, zero_pseudo]
    rw [if_neg r'_ne_zero] at ih
    split at ih <;> expose_names
    · exact ih
    suffices (r'.pseudo a).remainder.degreeOf c ≤ r'.degreeOf c by exact lt_of_le_of_lt this ih
    apply degreeOf_pseudo_remainder_le_of_degreeOf_eq_zero
    apply (iff_not_comm.mpr mem_vars_iff_degreeOf_ne_zero).mpr
    apply Finset.notMem_of_max_lt_coe
    apply heq ▸ (pairwise_cons.mp hl2).1 p hp

name: setPseudo_remainder_reducedToSet
statement: theorem setPseudo_remainder_reducedToSet : (g.setPseudo S).remainder.reducedToSet S
proof:
:= by
  rw [reducedToSet_iff, setPseudo_remainder_eq_setPseudoRem, setPseudoRem]
  intro i hi
  apply setPseudoRem_reducedTo _ S.toList_non_zero S.toList_pairwise
  exact mem_toList_iff.mpr <| apply_mem hi

name: setPseudo_remainder_isSetRemainder
statement: theorem setPseudo_remainder_isSetRemainder : (g.setPseudo S).remainder.IsSetRemainder g S
proof:
:=
  ⟨g.setPseudo_remainder_reducedToSet S, _, _,
    ⟨g.length_setPseudo_exponents S, g.length_setPseudo_quotients S⟩, g.setPseudo_equation S⟩

name: isSetRemainder_of_eq_setPseudo_remainder
statement:
theorem isSetRemainder_of_eq_setPseudo_remainder {r g : MvPolynomial σ R}
    {S : TriangularSet σ R} : (g.setPseudo S).remainder = r → r.IsSetRemainder g S
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  h ▸ g.setPseudo_remainder_isSetRemainder S

name: setPseudoRem_eq_self_of_max_vars_lt
statement:
lemma setPseudoRem_eq_self_of_max_vars_lt (l : List (MvPolynomial σ R))
    (hl1 : ∀ ⦃p⦄, p ∈ l → p ≠ 0) (hl2 : l.Pairwise fun p q ↦ p.vars.max < q.vars.max) :
    ∀ ⦃g : MvPolynomial σ R⦄, (∀ p ∈ l, g.vars.max < p.vars.max) →
    l.foldr (fun p r ↦ (r.pseudo p).remainder) g = g
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp only [foldr_nil, implies_true]
  | cons a l ih =>
    intro g hg
    simp only [mem_cons, forall_eq_or_imp] at hg
    rcases WithBot.ne_bot_iff_exists.mp <| LT.lt.ne_bot hg.1 with ⟨c, hc⟩
    have ih := ih (fun p hp ↦ hl1 <| mem_cons_of_mem _ hp) (pairwise_cons.mp hl2).2 hg.2
    rw [foldr_cons, ih, pseudo_remainder_eq_of_degreeOf_eq_zero hc.symm]
    apply (iff_not_comm.mpr mem_vars_iff_degreeOf_ne_zero).mpr
    apply Finset.notMem_of_max_lt_coe <| hc ▸ hg.1

name: setPseudo_remainder_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
theorem setPseudo_remainder_eq_zero_of_mem {p : MvPolynomial σ R} (hp : p ∈ S) :
    (p.setPseudo S).remainder = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases hp with ⟨n, hn1, hn2⟩
  rw [setPseudo_remainder_eq_setPseudoRem, setPseudoRem]
  let l1 := S.toList.drop (n + 1)
  let l2 := S.toList.take n
  have hmin : min n S.length = n := Nat.min_eq_left (le_of_lt hn1)
  have : S.toList = l2 ++ [p] ++ l1 := by
    have : (l2 ++ [p]).length = n + 1 := by simpa [l2] using (le_of_lt hn1)
    simp only [l1, ← this]
    refine prefix_append_drop <| prefix_iff_eq_take.mpr ?_
    have := S.length_toList ▸ hn1
    simp [l2, hmin, take_add_one, hn2 ▸ toList_getElem this ▸ getElem?_eq_getElem this]
  simp only [this, append_assoc, cons_append, nil_append, foldr_append, foldr_cons]
  suffices ((l1.foldr (fun p r ↦ (r.pseudo p).remainder) p).pseudo p).remainder = 0 by
    rw [this, zero_setPseudoRem]
  simp only [← toList_drop, l1]
  refine pseudo_remainder_eq_zero_of_dvd (dvd_of_eq <| Eq.symm ?_)
  refine setPseudoRem_eq_self_of_max_vars_lt _ (toList_non_zero _) (toList_pairwise _) ?_
  intro q hq
  rcases mem_toList_iff.mp hq with ⟨i, hi1, hi2⟩
  rw [← hn2, ← hi2, drop_apply]
  refine max_vars_lt_of_index_lt ?_ (Nat.lt_add_right i (lt_add_one n))
  exact Nat.add_lt_of_lt_sub' (S.length_drop _ ▸ hi1)

name: degrees_eq_zero_iff_support_subset_zero
statement: theorem degrees_eq_zero_iff_support_subset_zero : p.degrees = 0 ↔ p.support ⊆ {0}
proof:
:= by
  rewrite [Finset.subset_singleton_iff', Multiset.eq_zero_iff_forall_notMem]
  refine ⟨fun h s hs ↦ ?_, fun h i hi ↦ ?_⟩
  · apply Finsupp.support_eq_empty.mp
    refine Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun i ↦ ?_
    have := (not_iff_not.mpr mem_degrees).mp (h i)
    have := not_and.mp <| not_exists.mp this s
    exact this (mem_support_iff.mp hs)
  rcases mem_degrees.mp hi with ⟨s, hs1, hs2⟩
  have := Finsupp.support_eq_empty.mpr (h s <| mem_support_iff.mpr hs1) ▸ hs2
  exact absurd this (Finset.notMem_empty i)

name: degreeOf_X_self
statement: @[simp] theorem degreeOf_X_self [Nontrivial R] (i : σ) : (X i : MvPolynomial σ R).degreeOf i = 1
proof:
:=

name: ne_zero_of_degreeOf_ne_zero
statement: lemma ne_zero_of_degreeOf_ne_zero {i : σ} : p.degreeOf i ≠ 0 → p ≠ 0
proof:
:=

name: degreeOf_X_self_pow
statement:
@[simp] theorem degreeOf_X_self_pow [Nontrivial R] (i : σ) (k : ℕ) :
    ((X i : MvPolynomial σ R) ^ k).degreeOf i = k
proof:
:= by
  rw [X_pow_eq_monomial, degreeOf_monomial_eq _ _ one_ne_zero, Finsupp.single_eq_same]

name: le_degreeOf_of_mem_support
statement:
lemma le_degreeOf_of_mem_support (i : σ) {s : σ →₀ ℕ} :
    s ∈ p.support → s i ≤ p.degreeOf i
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  by_cases si : s i = 0
  · simp only [si, zero_le]
  have : 0 < s i := Nat.zero_lt_of_ne_zero si
  rewrite [degreeOf_eq_sup, Finset.le_sup_iff this]
  use s

name: notMem_support_of_degreeOf_lt
statement: lemma notMem_support_of_degreeOf_lt (i : σ) {s : σ →₀ ℕ} : p.degreeOf i < s i → s ∉ p.support
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ by contrapose! h; exact le_degreeOf_of_mem_support i h

name: degreeOf_X_pow_of_ne
statement:
theorem degreeOf_X_pow_of_ne {i j : σ} (k : ℕ) (h : i ≠ j) :
    ((X j : MvPolynomial σ R) ^ k).degreeOf i = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, ← C_1, degreeOf_C]
  | succ k hk => rw [pow_add, pow_one, degreeOf_mul_X_of_ne _ h, hk]

name: degreeOf_X_of_ne
statement: theorem degreeOf_X_of_ne {i j : σ} (h : i ≠ j) : (X j : MvPolynomial σ R).degreeOf i = 0
proof:
:=
  pow_one (X j : MvPolynomial σ R) ▸ degreeOf_X_pow_of_ne 1 h

name: degreeOf_mul_X_self_pow_eq_add_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem degreeOf_mul_X_self_pow_eq_add_of_ne_zero (i : σ) (k : ℕ) (h : p ≠ 0) :
    (p * X i ^ k).degreeOf i = p.degreeOf i + k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, mul_one, add_zero]
  | succ k hk =>
    have : p * X i ^ k ≠ 0 := by
      rcases ne_zero_iff.mp h with ⟨s, hs⟩
      refine ne_zero_iff.mpr ⟨s + Finsupp.single i k, ?_⟩
      rewrite [X_pow_eq_monomial, coeff_mul_monomial, mul_one]
      exact hs
    rewrite [pow_add, pow_one, ← mul_assoc]
    rw [(degreeOf_mul_X_eq_degreeOf_add_one_iff i _).mpr this, hk, add_assoc]

name: degreeOf_mul_X_pow_of_ne
statement:
theorem degreeOf_mul_X_pow_of_ne {i j : σ} (k : ℕ) (h : i ≠ j) :
    (p * X j ^ k).degreeOf i = p.degreeOf i
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, mul_one]
  | succ k hk => rw [pow_add, pow_one, ← mul_assoc, degreeOf_mul_X_of_ne _ h, hk]

name: degreeOf_add_eq_of_degreeOf_lt
statement:
theorem degreeOf_add_eq_of_degreeOf_lt {i : σ} (h : q.degreeOf i < p.degreeOf i) :
    (p + q).degreeOf i = p.degreeOf i
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm ((max_eq_left_of_lt h) ▸ degreeOf_add_le i p q)
  nth_rewrite 2 [degreeOf_eq_sup]
  apply (Finset.le_sup_iff <| Nat.zero_lt_of_lt h).mpr
  have : p.support.Nonempty := by apply support_nonempty.mpr; contrapose! h; simp [h]
  have ⟨s, hs1, hs2⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup _ this (fun s ↦ s i)
  rewrite [← degreeOf_eq_sup i p] at hs2
  refine ⟨s, ?_, by rw [hs2]⟩
  have : s ∉ q.support := by contrapose! h; exact hs2 ▸ le_degreeOf_of_mem_support i h
  simp only [mem_support_iff, ne_eq, coeff_add, not_not] at hs1 ⊢ this
  rewrite [this, add_zero]
  exact hs1

name: degreeOf_eq_of_degreeOf_add_lt
statement:
theorem degreeOf_eq_of_degreeOf_add_lt {i : σ} (h : (p + q).degreeOf i < p.degreeOf i) :
    p.degreeOf i = q.degreeOf i
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! h
  apply le_trans (Nat.le_max_left _ (q.degreeOf i))
  rcases Nat.lt_or_lt_of_ne h with h | h
  · simp only [add_comm p q, degreeOf_add_eq_of_degreeOf_lt h, max_eq_right_of_lt h, le_refl]
  simp only [degreeOf_add_eq_of_degreeOf_lt h, max_eq_left_of_lt h, le_refl]

name: mem_vars_iff_degreeOf_ne_zero
statement: theorem mem_vars_iff_degreeOf_ne_zero {i : σ} : i ∈ p.vars ↔ p.degreeOf i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical rw [degreeOf, vars_def, Multiset.mem_toFinset, Multiset.count_ne_zero]

name: support_subset_vars_of_mem_support
statement:
theorem support_subset_vars_of_mem_support {s : σ →₀ ℕ} (h : s ∈ p.support) :
    s.support ⊆ p.vars
proof:
:= fun i hi ↦ by
  contrapose! hi
  have := mem_support_notMem_vars_zero h hi
  exact Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mpr this

name: vars_eq_empty_iff_eq_C
statement: theorem vars_eq_empty_iff_eq_C : p.vars = ∅ ↔ p = C (p.coeff 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ by rw [h]; simp⟩
  rw [← totalDegree_eq_zero_iff_eq_C]
  suffices p.degrees.card = 0 by grind [totalDegree_le_degrees_card p]
  classical rw [vars_def, Multiset.toFinset_eq_empty] at h
  simp_all

name: initialOf_def
statement:
theorem initialOf_def {p : MvPolynomial σ R} {i : σ} :
    p.initialOf i = ∑ s ∈ p.support with s i = p.degreeOf i, monomial (s.erase i) (p.coeff s)
proof: := rfl

name: initialOf_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem initialOf_zero : (0 : MvPolynomial σ R).initialOf i = 0
proof: := rfl

name: initialOf_monomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem initialOf_monomial (s : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R) :
    (monomial s r).initialOf i = monomial (s.erase i) r
proof:
:= by
  by_cases r_zero : r = 0
  · simp only [r_zero, monomial_zero, initialOf_zero]
  rw [initialOf_def, Finset.sum_filter, ← single_eq_monomial, degreeOf_eq_sup, support]
  rw [Finsupp.support_single_ne_zero s r_zero, Finset.sum_singleton, Finset.sup_singleton]
  rw [if_pos rfl, coeff, Finsupp.single_eq_same]

name: initialOf_C
statement: @[simp] theorem initialOf_C (r : R) : (C r : MvPolynomial σ R).initialOf i = C r
proof:
:= by
  rw [C_apply, initialOf_monomial, Finsupp.erase_zero]

name: initialOf_one
statement: @[simp] theorem initialOf_one : (1 : MvPolynomial σ R).initialOf i = 1
proof: := by rw [← C_1, initialOf_C]

name: initialOf_mul_X_self
statement: @[simp] theorem initialOf_mul_X_self : (p * X i).initialOf i = p.initialOf i
proof:
:= by
  by_cases p_zero : p = 0
  · rw [p_zero, zero_mul, initialOf_zero]
  rw [initialOf_def, (degreeOf_mul_X_eq_degreeOf_add_one_iff i p).mpr p_zero]
  simp [Finset.sum_filter, initialOf_def]

name: initialOf_mul_X_of_ne
statement:
theorem initialOf_mul_X_of_ne {i j : σ} (h : i ≠ j) :

proof:
:= by
  rw [initialOf_def, degreeOf_mul_X_of_ne _ h]
  simp [h, monomial_add_single, initialOf_def, Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_mul]

name: initialOf_mul_X_self_pow
statement: @[simp] theorem initialOf_mul_X_self_pow (k : ℕ) : (p * X i ^ k).initialOf i = p.initialOf i
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, mul_one]
  | succ k hk => rw [pow_add, pow_one, ← mul_assoc, initialOf_mul_X_self, hk]

name: initialOf_mul_X_pow_of_ne
statement:
theorem initialOf_mul_X_pow_of_ne {i j : σ} (k : ℕ) (h : i ≠ j) :
    (p * X j ^ k).initialOf i = p.initialOf i * X j ^ k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, mul_one, mul_one]
  | succ k hk => rw [pow_add, pow_one, ← mul_assoc, initialOf_mul_X_of_ne _ h, hk, mul_assoc]

name: initialOf_X_self
statement: @[simp] theorem initialOf_X_self : (X i).initialOf i = (1 : MvPolynomial σ R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← one_mul (X i), initialOf_mul_X_self, initialOf_one]

name: initialOf_X_self_pow
statement: @[simp] theorem initialOf_X_self_pow (k : ℕ) : (X i ^ k).initialOf i = (1 : MvPolynomial σ R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← one_mul (X i ^ k), initialOf_mul_X_self_pow, initialOf_one]

name: initialOf_X_of_ne
statement: theorem initialOf_X_of_ne {i j : σ} (h : i ≠ j) : (X j).initialOf i = (X j : MvPolynomial σ R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← one_mul (X j), initialOf_mul_X_of_ne _ h, initialOf_one]

name: initialOf_X_pow_of_ne
statement:
theorem initialOf_X_pow_of_ne {i j : σ} (k : ℕ) (h : i ≠ j) :
    (X j ^ k).initialOf i = (X j : MvPolynomial σ R) ^ k
proof:
