name: coeff_initialOf_eq_of_apply_ne_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_initialOf_eq_of_apply_ne_zero {s : σ →₀ ℕ} (h : s i ≠ 0) :
    (p.initialOf i).coeff s = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [initialOf, coeff_sum, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ ↦ coeff_monomial s _ _]
  have (x : σ →₀ ℕ) : x.erase i = s ↔ False := by
    refine iff_false_intro <| Finsupp.ne_iff.mpr ⟨i, ?_⟩
    rw [Finsupp.erase_apply, if_pos rfl]
    exact h.symm
  simp only [this, ↓reduceIte, Finset.sum_const_zero]

name: coeff_initialOf_eq_of_apply_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_initialOf_eq_of_apply_eq_zero {s : σ →₀ ℕ} (h : s i = 0) :
    (p.initialOf i).coeff s = p.coeff (s.update i (p.degreeOf i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [initialOf, coeff_sum, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ ↦ coeff_monomial s _ _]
  have (x : σ →₀ ℕ) : x i = p.degreeOf i ∧ x.erase i = s ↔ x = s.update i (p.degreeOf i) := by
    refine ⟨fun hx ↦ Finsupp.ext fun j ↦ ?_, fun hx ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [Finsupp.update_apply]
      split_ifs with hj
      · rw [hj, hx.1]
      rw [← hx.2, Finsupp.erase_apply, if_neg hj]
    simp only [hx, Finsupp.update_apply, reduceIte, Finsupp.erase_update_eq_erase, true_and]
    refine Finsupp.erase_of_notMem_support ?_
    exact Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mpr h
  simpa [Finset.sum_filter, ← ite_and, this] using Eq.symm

name: coeff_initialOf_eq
statement:
theorem coeff_initialOf_eq (s : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    (p.initialOf i).coeff s = if s i = 0 then p.coeff (s.update i (p.degreeOf i)) else 0
proof:
:=
  if hs : s i = 0 then if_pos hs ▸ coeff_initialOf_eq_of_apply_eq_zero i p hs
  else if_neg hs ▸ coeff_initialOf_eq_of_apply_ne_zero i p hs

name: coeff_initialOf_eq_of_ne_zero
statement:
lemma coeff_initialOf_eq_of_ne_zero {i : σ} {p : MvPolynomial σ R} {s : σ →₀ ℕ} :
    (p.initialOf i).coeff s ≠ 0 → (p.initialOf i).coeff s = p.coeff (s.update i (p.degreeOf i))
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ coeff_initialOf_eq_of_apply_eq_zero i p
    (by contrapose! h; exact (coeff_initialOf_eq_of_apply_ne_zero i p) h)

name: degreeOf_initialOf_self
statement: @[simp] theorem degreeOf_initialOf_self : (p.initialOf i).degreeOf i = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Multiset.count_eq_zero.mpr
  apply (not_iff_not.mpr mem_degrees).mpr
  simp only [ne_eq, Finsupp.mem_support_iff, not_exists, not_and, Decidable.not_not]
  intro s hs
  contrapose! hs
  exact coeff_initialOf_eq_of_apply_ne_zero i p hs

name: initialOf_eq_leadingCoeff
statement:
theorem initialOf_eq_leadingCoeff [DecidableEq σ] {p : MvPolynomial σ R} {i : σ} :
    p.initialOf i = rename Subtype.val
      (optionEquivLeft R {b // b ≠ i} (rename (Equiv.optionSubtypeNe i).symm p)).leadingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  set f := (Equiv.optionSubtypeNe i).symm
  have hsv : Subtype.val = f.symm ∘ (@some { b // b ≠ i }) := rfl
  by_cases hs : s i ≠ 0
  · suffices (rename Subtype.val
        ((optionEquivLeft R { b // b ≠ i }) ((rename ⇑f) p)).leadingCoeff).degreeOf i = 0 by
      have hsc : (p.initialOf i).coeff s = 0 := by
        apply notMem_support_iff.mp
        apply p.degreeOf_initialOf_self i ▸ notMem_support_of_degreeOf_lt i
        exact Nat.zero_lt_of_ne_zero hs
      rw [hsc]
      apply Eq.symm <| notMem_support_iff.mp ?_
      apply this ▸ notMem_support_of_degreeOf_lt i
      exact Nat.zero_lt_of_ne_zero hs
    simp [degreeOf, degrees_rename_of_injective Subtype.val_injective]
  rw [not_ne_iff] at hs
  rw [Polynomial.leadingCoeff, ← degreeOf_eq_natDegree]
  set s' : { b // b ≠ i } →₀ ℕ := (s.mapDomain f).some with hs'
  have : s'.mapDomain Subtype.val = s := by
    rw [hs', Finsupp.some, hsv, Finsupp.mapDomain_comp,
      Finsupp.mapDomain_comapDomain _ (Option.some_injective _)]
    · ext j
      simp [Finsupp.mapDomain_equiv_apply]
    refine Finsupp.support_subset_iff.mpr ?_
    simp only [Set.mem_range, Subtype.exists, not_exists, Finsupp.mapDomain_equiv_apply]
    intro j hj
    contrapose! hj
    refine ⟨f.symm j, by contrapose! hj; rw [hj, hs], ?_⟩
    have : f ∘ Subtype.val = @some { b // b ≠ i } := (Equiv.symm_comp_eq _ _ _).mpr hsv
    simp only [ne_eq, ← this, Function.comp_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [← this, coeff_rename_mapDomain _ Subtype.val_injective, this,
    optionEquivLeft_coeff_coeff, ← coeff_rename_mapDomain _ f.symm.injective]
  simp only [rename_rename, ne_eq, Equiv.symm_comp_self, rename_id, AlgHom.coe_id, id_eq]
  have (n : ℕ) : (s'.optionElim n).mapDomain f.symm = s.update i n := by
    ext j
    simp only [ne_eq, Finsupp.some, Finsupp.mapDomain_equiv_apply, Equiv.symm_symm,
      Finsupp.optionElim_apply_eq_elim, Finsupp.update_apply, s', Option.elim]
    have : f i = none := Equiv.optionSubtypeNe_symm_self i
    split <;> expose_names
    · have : j ≠ i := fun hj ↦ by absurd heq; rw [hj, this]; exact not_eq_of_beq_eq_false rfl
      rw [if_neg this, Finsupp.comapDomain_apply, ← heq, Finsupp.mapDomain_apply f.injective]
    have : j = i := by apply f.injective; rw [this, heq]
    rw [if_pos this]
  exact this _ ▸ coeff_initialOf_eq_of_apply_eq_zero i p hs

name: vars_initialOf_subset
statement: theorem vars_initialOf_subset : (p.initialOf i).vars ⊆ p.vars
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply subset_trans (vars_sum_subset _ _)
  simp only [Finset.biUnion_subset_iff_forall_subset, Finset.mem_filter, mem_support_iff, ne_eq]
  intro s ⟨hs, _⟩
  simp only [vars_monomial hs, Finsupp.support_erase]
  apply subset_trans (Finset.erase_subset i s.support)
  exact support_subset_vars_of_mem_support <| mem_support_iff.mpr hs

name: initialOf_eq_of_degreeOf_eq_zero
statement:
theorem initialOf_eq_of_degreeOf_eq_zero {p : MvPolynomial σ R} {i : σ} :
    p.degreeOf i = 0 → p.initialOf i = p
proof:
:= fun h ↦ Eq.symm (by
  nth_rw 1 [p.as_sum, initialOf_def, Finset.sum_filter]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun s hs ↦ ?_)
  simp [h, Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero <| degreeOf_le_iff.mp (le_of_eq h) s hs])

name: degreeOf_initialOf_le
statement: theorem degreeOf_initialOf_le : (p.initialOf i).degreeOf j ≤ p.degreeOf j
proof:
:= by
  refine le_trans (degreeOf_sum_le ..) <| Finset.sup_le ?_
  intro s hs
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, mem_support_iff, ne_eq] at hs
  rw [degreeOf_monomial_eq _ _ hs.1, degreeOf_eq_sup]
  by_cases hi : i = j
  · rw [hi, Finsupp.erase_same]
    exact Nat.zero_le _
  rw [Finsupp.erase_ne (Ne.symm hi)]
  apply Finset.le_sup <| mem_support_iff.mpr hs.1

name: initialOf_add_eq_of_degreeOf_lt
statement:
theorem initialOf_add_eq_of_degreeOf_lt {i : σ} {p q : MvPolynomial σ R}
    (h : q.degreeOf i < p.degreeOf i) : (p + q).initialOf i = p.initialOf i
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  rw [coeff_initialOf_eq, coeff_initialOf_eq, degreeOf_add_eq_of_degreeOf_lt h, coeff_add]
  split_ifs with hs
  · suffices q.coeff (s.update i (degreeOf i p)) = 0 by rw [this, add_zero]
    refine notMem_support_iff.mp <| notMem_support_of_degreeOf_lt i ?_
    classical simpa only [Finsupp.update_apply, reduceIte]
  rfl

name: degreeOf_eq_of_initialOf_decomposition
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nontrivial R := have ⟨s, hs⟩ := ne_zero_iff.mp q_ne; ⟨q.coeff s, 0, hs⟩
  have := degreeOf_mul_le i q (X i ^ d)
  rw [hq, zero_add] at this
  have := le_trans (degreeOf_add_le i (q * X i ^ d) r) (sup_le_sup_right this (r.degreeOf i))
  rw [← decomp, degreeOf_X_self_pow, max_eq_left_of_lt hr] at this
  apply le_antisymm this
  have d_eq := degreeOf_mul_X_self_pow_eq_add_of_ne_zero i d q_ne
  have : r.degreeOf i < (q * X i ^ d).degreeOf i :=
    d_eq ▸ (lt_of_lt_of_le hr <| Nat.le_add_left d _)
  rw [decomp, degreeOf_add_eq_of_degreeOf_lt this, d_eq]
  exact Nat.le_add_left d _

name: initialOf_initialOf_self
statement: @[simp] theorem initialOf_initialOf_self : (p.initialOf i).initialOf i = p.initialOf i
proof:
:=
  initialOf_eq_of_degreeOf_eq_zero <| degreeOf_initialOf_self ..

name: initialOf_eq_iff_degreeOf_eq_zero
statement:
theorem initialOf_eq_iff_degreeOf_eq_zero {i : σ} {p : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    p.degreeOf i = 0 ↔ p.initialOf i = p
proof:
:=
  ⟨initialOf_eq_of_degreeOf_eq_zero, fun h ↦ by rw [h.symm, degreeOf_initialOf_self]⟩

name: _initialOf_decomposition
statement:
protected lemma _initialOf_decomposition :
    let q
proof:
:= ∑ s ∈ p.support with s i ≠ p.degreeOf i, (monomial s) (p.coeff s)
    q.degreeOf i ≤ p.degreeOf i - 1 ∧ p = p.initialOf i * X i ^ p.degreeOf i + q := by
  classical
  set q := ∑ s ∈ p.support with s i ≠ p.degreeOf i, (monomial s) (p.coeff s) with hq
  simp only
  constructor
  · rw [degreeOf_eq_sup, Finset.sup_le_iff]
    intro s hs
    rw [hq,  mem_support_iff, coeff_sum, Finset.sum_filter] at hs
    set f := fun t ↦ if t i ≠ p.degreeOf i then (monomial t (p.coeff t)).coeff s else 0 with hf
    have hf : f = fun t ↦ if t = s then (if t i ≠ p.degreeOf i then (p.coeff t) else 0) else 0 :=
      by ext t; simp only [hf, coeff_monomial]; rw [← ite_and]; simp only [and_comm, ite_and]
    simp only [hf, ne_eq, Finset.sum_ite_eq', mem_support_iff, ite_eq_right_iff,
      Classical.not_imp] at hs
    have : s i ≤ p.degreeOf i := le_degreeOf_of_mem_support i <| mem_support_iff.mpr hs.1
    by_cases d_zero : p.degreeOf i = 0
    · rw [d_zero] at this ⊢
      exact this
    exact Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt <| lt_of_le_of_ne this hs.2.1
  rw [initialOf_def, Finset.sum_mul, hq, Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_filter, X_pow_eq_monomial]
  simp only [monomial_mul, mul_one, ne_eq, ite_not, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  nth_rw 1 [as_sum p]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun s _ ↦ ?_)
  split_ifs with hs
  · rw [← hs, Finsupp.erase_add_single, add_zero]
  rw [zero_add]

name: initialOf_decomposition
statement:
theorem initialOf_decomposition : ∃ q, q.degreeOf i ≤ p.degreeOf i - 1 ∧
    p = p.initialOf i * X i ^ p.degreeOf i + q
proof: := ⟨_, p._initialOf_decomposition i⟩

name: initialOf_ne_zero
statement: theorem initialOf_ne_zero {p : MvPolynomial σ R} : p ≠ 0 → p.initialOf i ≠ 0
proof:
:= mt fun h ↦ by
  obtain ⟨q, hq1, hq2⟩ := p.initialOf_decomposition i
  rw [h, zero_mul, zero_add] at hq2
  rw [← hq2] at hq1
  have : p.degreeOf i = 0 := by contrapose! hq1; exact Nat.sub_one_lt hq1
  exact initialOf_eq_of_degreeOf_eq_zero this ▸ h

name: initialOf_ne_zero_of_degreeOf_ne_zero
statement:
theorem initialOf_ne_zero_of_degreeOf_ne_zero {i : σ} {p : MvPolynomial σ R} : p.degreeOf i ≠ 0 →
    p.initialOf i ≠ 0
proof: := fun h ↦ (initialOf_ne_zero i) (ne_zero_of_degreeOf_ne_zero h)

name: degreeOf_add_lt_of_initialOf_cancel
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p', hp1, hp2⟩ := p.initialOf_decomposition i
  obtain ⟨q', hq1, hq2⟩ := q.initialOf_decomposition i
  set d := p.degreeOf i with hd'
  have : p' + q' = p + q :=
    calc p' + q' = (p.initialOf i + q.initialOf i) * X i ^ d + p' + q' := by simp [hi]
      _ = p.initialOf i * X i ^ d + p' + (q.initialOf i * X i ^ d + q') := by ring
      _ = p + q := by rw [← hp2, hd, ← hq2]
  rw [← this]
  exact le_trans (degreeOf_add_le i p' q') <| max_le hp1 (hd ▸ hq1)

name: initialOf_cancel_of_degreeOf_add_lt
statement:
theorem initialOf_cancel_of_degreeOf_add_lt {i : σ} {p q : MvPolynomial σ R}
    (h : (p + q).degreeOf i < p.degreeOf i) : p.initialOf i + q.initialOf i = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  simp only [coeff_add, coeff_initialOf_eq, coeff_zero]
  split_ifs with hs
  · have : p.degreeOf i = q.degreeOf i := by
      contrapose! h
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne h with h | h
      · rw [add_comm, degreeOf_add_eq_of_degreeOf_lt h]
        exact Nat.le_of_succ_le h
      rw [degreeOf_add_eq_of_degreeOf_lt h]
    rw [← this, ← coeff_add]
    refine notMem_support_iff.mp <| notMem_support_of_degreeOf_lt i ?_
    classical simpa only [Finsupp.update_apply]
  rw [add_zero]

name: initialOf_eq_of_initialOf_decomposition
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  have d_eq : p.degreeOf i = d := degreeOf_eq_of_initialOf_decomposition q_ne hq hr decomp
  simp only [coeff_initialOf_eq, d_eq]
  split_ifs with hs
  · suffices r.coeff (s + Finsupp.single i d) = 0 by
      classical simp [decomp, X_pow_eq_monomial, coeff_mul_monomial',
        Finsupp.update_eq_add_single hs, this]
    refine notMem_support_iff.mp <| notMem_support_of_degreeOf_lt i ?_
    simpa using Nat.lt_add_left (s i) hr
  refine Eq.symm <| notMem_support_iff.mp <| notMem_support_of_degreeOf_lt i ?_
  exact hq ▸ Nat.zero_lt_of_ne_zero hs

name: initialOf_add_of_degreeOf_eq_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  by_cases pd_zero : p.degreeOf i = 0
  · have pI : p.initialOf i = p := initialOf_eq_of_degreeOf_eq_zero pd_zero
    have qI : q.initialOf i = q := initialOf_eq_of_degreeOf_eq_zero <| h ▸ pd_zero
    have := degreeOf_add_le i p q
    simp only [pd_zero, h, max_self, nonpos_iff_eq_zero] at this
    rw [initialOf_eq_of_degreeOf_eq_zero this, pI, qI]
  obtain ⟨p', hp1, hp2⟩ := p.initialOf_decomposition i
  obtain ⟨q', hq1, hq2⟩ := q.initialOf_decomposition i
  have pd_zero : 0 < p.degreeOf i := Nat.zero_lt_of_ne_zero pd_zero
  have hp1 : degreeOf i p' < degreeOf i p := Nat.lt_of_le_pred pd_zero hp1
  have hq1 : degreeOf i q' < degreeOf i p := Nat.lt_of_le_pred pd_zero (h ▸ hq1)
  have decomp : p + q = (p.initialOf i + q.initialOf i) * X i ^ p.degreeOf i + (p' + q') :=
    by nth_rw 1 [hp2, hq2, h]; ring
  have d_zero : (p.initialOf i + q.initialOf i).degreeOf i = 0 := by
    refine Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero <| le_trans (degreeOf_add_le ..) ?_
    simp only [degreeOf_initialOf_self, max_self, le_refl]
  have hlt : (p' + q').degreeOf i < p.degreeOf i :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (degreeOf_add_le ..) <| max_lt hp1 hq1
  exact initialOf_eq_of_initialOf_decomposition hi d_zero hlt decomp

name: initialOf_mul_decomposition
statement:
theorem initialOf_mul_decomposition : ∃ r, r.degreeOf i ≤ p.degreeOf i + q.degreeOf i - 1
    ∧ p * q = p.initialOf i * q.initialOf i * X i ^ (p.degreeOf i + q.degreeOf i) + r
proof:
:= by
  by_cases this : p.degreeOf i = 0 ∨ q.degreeOf i = 0
  · rcases this with h | h <;>
    have {p q : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : q.degreeOf i = 0) :
        ∃ r, r.degreeOf i ≤ p.degreeOf i + q.degreeOf i - 1
          ∧ p * q = p.initialOf i * q.initialOf i * X i ^ (p.degreeOf i + q.degreeOf i) + r := by
      obtain ⟨p', hp1, hp2⟩ := p.initialOf_decomposition i
      rw [initialOf_eq_of_degreeOf_eq_zero h]
      refine ⟨q * p', ?_, by nth_rw 1 [h, add_zero, hp2]; ring⟩
      refine le_trans (degreeOf_mul_le ..) ?_
      simpa [initialOf_eq_of_degreeOf_eq_zero, h] using hp1
    · rw [add_comm, mul_comm, mul_comm (p.initialOf i)]
      exact this h
    exact this h
  obtain ⟨p', hp1, hp2⟩ := p.initialOf_decomposition i
  obtain ⟨q', hq1, hq2⟩ := q.initialOf_decomposition i
  use q.initialOf i * X i ^ q.degreeOf i * p' + p.initialOf i * X i ^ p.degreeOf i * q' + p' * q'
  refine ⟨?_, by nth_rw 1 [hp2, hq2]; ring⟩
  have hp := Nat.zero_lt_of_ne_zero (not_or.mp this).1
  have hq := Nat.zero_lt_of_ne_zero (not_or.mp this).2
  have : (p' * q').degreeOf i ≤ p.degreeOf i + q.degreeOf i - 1 := by
    refine le_trans (degreeOf_mul_le i p' q') <| le_trans (add_le_add hp1 hq1) ?_
    simp [Nat.add_sub_assoc hq _]
  refine le_trans (degreeOf_add_le ..) (max_le ?_ this)
  refine le_trans (degreeOf_add_le ..) (max_le ?_ ?_)
  <;> refine le_trans (degreeOf_mul_le i ..) ?_
  · rw [add_comm (p.degreeOf i), Nat.add_sub_assoc hp _, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, zero_add]
    apply add_le_add ?_ hp1
    have : q.initialOf i ≠ 0 := initialOf_ne_zero_of_degreeOf_ne_zero <| Nat.ne_zero_of_lt hq
    rw [degreeOf_mul_X_self_pow_eq_add_of_ne_zero _ _ this, degreeOf_initialOf_self, zero_add]
  rw [Nat.add_sub_assoc hq _, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, zero_add]
  apply add_le_add ?_ hq1
  have : p.initialOf i ≠ 0 := initialOf_ne_zero_of_degreeOf_ne_zero <| Nat.ne_zero_of_lt hp
  rw [degreeOf_mul_X_self_pow_eq_add_of_ne_zero _ _ this, degreeOf_initialOf_self, zero_add]

name: initial_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem initial_zero : (0 : MvPolynomial σ R).initial = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [initial, reduceIte]

name: initial_ne_zero
statement: theorem initial_ne_zero [Nontrivial R] {p : MvPolynomial σ R} : p ≠ 0 → p.initial ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  simp only [initial, h, ↓reduceIte, ne_eq]
  match p.vars.max with
  | none => simp only [one_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true]
  | some c => simp only [initialOf_ne_zero c h, not_false_eq_true]

name: initial_of_max_vars_eq_bot
statement: theorem initial_of_max_vars_eq_bot (hp : p ≠ 0) : p.vars.max = ⊥ → initial p = 1
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ by simp only [initial, hp, reduceIte, h]

name: initial_of_max_vars_isSome'
statement:
theorem initial_of_max_vars_isSome' {c : σ} :
    p.vars.max = c → initial p = p.initialOf c
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  have : p.vars.max ≠ ⊥ := WithBot.ne_bot_iff_exists.mpr <| Exists.intro c h.symm
  have : p ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ absurd this (by simp [h])
  simp only [initial, this, ↓reduceIte, h]

name: initial_of_max_vars_isSome
statement:
theorem initial_of_max_vars_isSome {c : σ} : p.vars.max = c →
    initial p = ∑ s ∈ p.support with s c = p.degreeOf c, monomial (s.erase c) (p.coeff s)
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ by rw [initial_of_max_vars_isSome' h, initialOf_def]

name: initial_C
statement: @[simp] theorem initial_C {r : R} (hr : r ≠ 0) : (C r : MvPolynomial σ R).initial = 1
proof:
:=
  initial_of_max_vars_eq_bot (C_ne_zero.mpr hr) (congrArg _ vars_C)

name: initial_monomial
statement:
theorem initial_monomial {s : σ →₀ ℕ} (r : R) {c : σ} :
    s.support.max = c → (monomial s r).initial = monomial (s.erase c) r
proof:
:= fun hs ↦ by
  by_cases r_zero : r = 0
  · simp only [r_zero, initial, monomial_zero, reduceIte]
  have : (monomial s r).vars.max = c := hs ▸ congrArg _ (vars_monomial r_zero)
  rw [initial_of_max_vars_isSome' this, initialOf_monomial]

name: initial_X_pow
statement:
@[simp] theorem initial_X_pow (i : σ) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (X i ^ k).initial = (1 : MvPolynomial σ R)
proof:
:= by
  have : (Finsupp.single i k).support.max = i := by
    rw [Finsupp.support_single_ne_zero _ hk]; exact rfl
  rw [X_pow_eq_monomial, initial_monomial 1 this, Finsupp.erase_single, monomial_zero', C_1]

name: initial_X
statement: @[simp] theorem initial_X (i : σ) : (X i : MvPolynomial σ R).initial = 1
proof:
:=
  pow_one (X i : MvPolynomial σ R) ▸ initial_X_pow i one_ne_zero

name: max_vars_initial_lt
statement:
theorem max_vars_initial_lt (hp : p.vars.max ≠ ⊥) :
    (initial p).vars.max < p.vars.max
proof:
:= by
  by_contra con
  have ⟨c, hc⟩ := WithBot.ne_bot_iff_exists.mp hp
  absurd p.degreeOf_initialOf_self c
  rw [initial_of_max_vars_isSome' hc.symm] at con
  have con : (p.initialOf c).vars.max = p.vars.max :=
    eq_of_le_of_not_lt (Finset.max_mono <| vars_initialOf_subset c p) con
  have con := Finset.mem_of_max (hc ▸ con)
  simpa only [degreeOf, Multiset.count_ne_zero, vars_def, Multiset.mem_toFinset] using con

name: degreeOf_initial_le
statement: theorem degreeOf_initial_le : p.initial.degreeOf i ≤ p.degreeOf i
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · simp only [hp, initial_zero, degreeOf_zero, le_refl]
  by_cases hc : p.vars.max = ⊥
  · simp only [initial_of_max_vars_eq_bot hp hc, degreeOf_one, zero_le]
  have ⟨c, hc⟩ :=  WithBot.ne_bot_iff_exists.mp hc
  exact initial_of_max_vars_isSome' hc.symm ▸ p.degreeOf_initialOf_le c i

name: initialProd_def
statement: theorem initialProd_def (PS : Finset (MvPolynomial σ R)) : initialProd PS = ∏ p ∈ PS, p.initial
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: initialOf_mul_eq
statement:
@[simp] theorem initialOf_mul_eq (q : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (p * q).initialOf i = p.initialOf i * q.initialOf i
proof:
:= by
  classical simp [initialOf_eq_leadingCoeff]

name: initialOf_smul
statement: @[simp] theorem initialOf_smul {r : R} : (r • p).initialOf i = r • p.initialOf i
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_eq_C_mul, smul_eq_C_mul, initialOf_mul_eq, initialOf_C]

name: initialOf_pow_eq
statement: @[simp] theorem initialOf_pow_eq (n : ℕ) : (p ^ n).initialOf i = p.initialOf i ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [pow_zero, initialOf_one]
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_add, pow_add, pow_one, pow_one, initialOf_mul_eq, ih]

name: initialOf_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem initialOf_neg (i : σ) : (-p).initialOf i = -p.initialOf i
proof:
:= by
  classical simp [initialOf_eq_leadingCoeff]

name: degreeOf_sub_lt_of_initialOf_eq
statement:
theorem degreeOf_sub_lt_of_initialOf_eq {i : σ} (hi : p.initialOf i = q.initialOf i)
    (hd : p.degreeOf i = q.degreeOf i) : (p - q).degreeOf i ≤ p.degreeOf i - 1
proof:
:=
  have hi : p.initialOf i + (-q).initialOf i = 0 := by rw [initialOf_neg i, hi, add_neg_cancel]
  have hd : p.degreeOf i = (-q).degreeOf i := by rw [degreeOf_neg, hd]
  sub_eq_add_neg p q ▸ degreeOf_add_lt_of_initialOf_cancel hd hi

name: initialOf_eq_of_degreeOf_sub_lt
statement:
theorem initialOf_eq_of_degreeOf_sub_lt {i : σ} {p q : MvPolynomial σ R}
    (h : (p - q).degreeOf i < p.degreeOf i) : p.initialOf i = q.initialOf i
proof:
:= by
  have : (p + (-q)).degreeOf i < p.degreeOf i := by rw [← sub_eq_add_neg]; exact h
  rw [← add_zero (p.initialOf i), ← add_neg_cancel ((-q).initialOf i), ← add_assoc,
    initialOf_cancel_of_degreeOf_add_lt this, zero_add, initialOf_neg, neg_neg]

name: order_eq_iff
statement:
theorem order_eq_iff : p.order = q.order ↔
    p.vars.max = q.vars.max ∧ p.mainDegree = q.mainDegree
proof: := Prod.mk_inj

name: le_def'
statement: theorem le_def' : p ≤ q ↔ p.order ≤ q.order
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: le_def
statement:
theorem le_def : p ≤ q ↔ p.vars.max < q.vars.max ∨
    p.vars.max = q.vars.max ∧ p.mainDegree ≤ q.mainDegree
proof: := Prod.lex_def

name: le_iff_not_imp
statement:
theorem le_iff_not_imp : p ≤ q ↔ ¬p.vars.max < q.vars.max →
    p.vars.max = q.vars.max ∧ p.mainDegree ≤ q.mainDegree
proof:
:=
  Iff.trans le_def <| Decidable.or_iff_not_imp_left

name: max_vars_le_of_le
statement: theorem max_vars_le_of_le : p ≤ q → p.vars.max ≤ q.vars.max
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ Or.elim (le_def.mp h) le_of_lt (fun h ↦ le_of_eq h.1)

name: lt_def'
statement: theorem lt_def' : p < q ↔ p.order < q.order
proof:
:= Iff.trans lt_iff_le_not_ge (by
  rw [le_def', le_def', not_le, and_iff_right_iff_imp]
  exact le_of_lt)

name: lt_def
statement:
theorem lt_def : p < q ↔ p.vars.max < q.vars.max ∨
    p.vars.max = q.vars.max ∧ p.mainDegree < q.mainDegree
proof:
:=
  Iff.trans lt_def' Prod.lex_def

name: lt_iff_not_imp
statement:
theorem lt_iff_not_imp : p < q ↔ ¬p.vars.max < q.vars.max
    → p.vars.max = q.vars.max ∧ p.mainDegree < q.mainDegree
proof:
:=
  Iff.trans lt_def <| Decidable.or_iff_not_imp_left

name: lt_of_max_vars_lt
statement: theorem lt_of_max_vars_lt : p.vars.max < q.vars.max → p < q
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ lt_def.mpr <| Or.inl h

name: not_lt_iff_ge
statement: @[simp] theorem not_lt_iff_ge : ¬(p < q) ↔ q ≤ p
proof: := by rw [le_def', lt_def', not_lt]

name: not_le_iff_gt
statement: @[simp] theorem not_le_iff_gt : ¬(p ≤ q) ↔ q < p
proof: := by rw [le_def', lt_def', not_le]

name: X_lt_of_lt
statement: theorem X_lt_of_lt [Nontrivial R] {i j : σ} : i < j → (X i : MvPolynomial σ R) < X j
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  apply lt_of_max_vars_lt; simpa only [vars_X, Finset.max_singleton, WithBot.coe_lt_coe] using h

name: equiv_def''
statement: theorem equiv_def'' : p ≈ q ↔ p ≤ q ∧ q ≤ p
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: equiv_def'
statement: theorem equiv_def' : p ≈ q ↔ p.order = q.order
proof:
:= Iff.trans equiv_def''
  (by rw [le_def', le_def']; exact Std.le_antisymm_iff)

name: equiv_def
statement: theorem equiv_def : p ≈ q ↔ ¬p < q ∧ ¬q < p
proof:
:= Iff.trans equiv_def''
  (by rw [not_lt_iff_ge, not_lt_iff_ge, and_comm])

name: equiv_iff
statement: theorem equiv_iff : p ≈ q ↔ p.vars.max = q.vars.max ∧ p.mainDegree = q.mainDegree
proof:
:=
  Iff.trans equiv_def' order_eq_iff

name: le_iff_lt_or_equiv
statement: theorem le_iff_lt_or_equiv : p ≤ q ↔ p < q ∨ p ≈ q
proof: := le_iff_lt_or_antisymmRel

name: lt_of_equiv_of_lt
statement: theorem lt_of_equiv_of_lt {r : MvPolynomial σ R} : p ≈ q → q < r → p < r
proof: := lt_of_antisymmRel_of_lt

name: lt_of_lt_of_equiv
statement: theorem lt_of_lt_of_equiv {r : MvPolynomial σ R} : p < q → q ≈ r → p < r
proof: := lt_of_lt_of_antisymmRel

name: equiv_of_le_of_ge
statement: theorem equiv_of_le_of_ge : p ≤ q → q ≤ p → p ≈ q
proof: := And.intro

name: zero_le
statement: protected theorem zero_le : 0 ≤ p
proof:
:=
  le_def'.mpr <| StrictMono.minimal_preimage_bot (fun ⦃_ _⦄ a ↦ a) rfl p.order

name: wellFoundedLT_variables_of_wellFoundedLT
statement:
theorem wellFoundedLT_variables_of_wellFoundedLT [Nontrivial R] :
    WellFoundedLT (MvPolynomial σ R) → WellFoundedLT σ
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  rw [WellFoundedLT, isWellFounded_iff, wellFounded_iff_isEmpty_descending_chain] at h ⊢
  contrapose! h
  rcases nonempty_subtype.mp h with ⟨f, hf⟩
  exact ⟨X ∘ f, fun n ↦ X_lt_of_lt <| hf n⟩

name: wellFoundedLT_iff
statement: theorem wellFoundedLT_iff [Nontrivial R] : WellFoundedLT (MvPolynomial σ R) ↔ WellFoundedLT σ
proof:
:=
  ⟨wellFoundedLT_variables_of_wellFoundedLT, @instWellFoundedLT _ _ _ _⟩

name: Set.has_min
statement: theorem Set.has_min (h : PS.Nonempty) : ∃ p ∈ PS, ∀ q ∈ PS, ¬q < p
proof:
:=
  haveI : WellFounded (· < ·) := @wellFounded_lt (MvPolynomial σ R) _ _
  WellFounded.has_min this PS h

name: Set.min_mem
statement: theorem Set.min_mem (h : PS.Nonempty) : (min PS h) ∈ PS
proof: := (Exists.choose_spec (has_min PS h)).1

name: apply_lt_of_index_lt
statement: theorem apply_lt_of_index_lt (h : n < S.length) : m < n → S m < S n
proof:
:=
  fun hmn ↦ MvPolynomial.lt_of_max_vars_lt <| max_vars_lt_of_index_lt h hmn

name: index_lt_of_apply_lt
statement: theorem index_lt_of_apply_lt (h : m < S.length) : S m < S n → m < n
proof:
:= fun hs ↦
  Decidable.byContradiction fun hmn ↦ False.elim <| match Nat.eq_or_lt_of_not_lt hmn with
    | Or.inl hmn => Eq.not_lt (congrArg S hmn) hs
    | Or.inr hmn => (MvPolynomial.not_lt_iff_ge.mpr <| le_of_lt hs) (apply_lt_of_index_lt h hmn)

name: le_of_index_le
statement: theorem le_of_index_le : m ≤ n → n < S.length → S m ≤ S n
proof:
:= fun hmn h ↦
  Or.elim (lt_or_eq_of_le hmn)
    (fun hmn ↦ le_of_lt <| MvPolynomial.lt_of_max_vars_lt <| max_vars_lt_of_index_lt h hmn)
    (fun hmn ↦ by simp only [hmn, le_refl])

name: order_def
statement: theorem order_def : S.order = fun i ↦ if i < S.length then WithTop.some (S i).order else ⊤
proof: := rfl

name: order_apply
statement: theorem order_apply {i : ℕ} (h : i < S.length) : S.order i = (S i).order
proof: := if_pos h

name: order_apply'
statement: theorem order_apply' {i : ℕ} (h : S.length ≤ i) : S.order i = ⊤
proof: := if_neg <| not_lt_of_ge h

name: order_lt_iff
statement:
theorem order_lt_iff : S.order < T.order ↔ (∃ k < S.length, S k < T k ∧ ∀ i < k, S i ≈ T i) ∨
    (T.length < S.length ∧ ∀ i < T.length, S i ≈ T i) where
  mp h
proof:
:= by
    rw [order_def, order_def, Pi.instLTLexForall] at h
    simp only [Pi.Lex] at h
    rcases h with ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩
    have klts : k < S.length := Decidable.byContradiction fun h ↦ not_top_lt <| if_neg h ▸ hk2
    rw [if_pos klts] at hk2
    by_cases kltt : k < T.length
    · rw [if_pos kltt, WithTop.coe_lt_coe, ← MvPolynomial.lt_def'] at hk2
      refine Or.inl ⟨k, klts, hk2, fun i hi ↦ ?_⟩
      have := hk1 i hi
      rw [if_pos <| lt_trans hi klts, if_pos <| lt_trans hi kltt, WithTop.coe_eq_coe] at this
      exact MvPolynomial.equiv_def'.mpr this
    have tlek : T.length ≤ k := Nat.le_of_not_lt kltt
    have tlts : T.length < S.length := lt_of_le_of_lt tlek klts
    refine Or.inr ⟨tlts, fun i hi ↦ ?_⟩
    have := hk1 i <| lt_of_lt_of_le hi tlek
    rw [if_pos (lt_trans hi tlts), if_pos hi, WithTop.coe_eq_coe] at this
    exact MvPolynomial.equiv_def'.mpr this
  mpr h := by
    rw [order_def, order_def, Pi.instLTLexForall]
    simp only [Pi.Lex]
    rcases h with (⟨k, hk, hk1, hk2⟩ | ⟨hlen, heq⟩)
    · use k ⊓ T.length
      constructor
      · intro i hi
        have hi := lt_min_iff.mp hi
        simp only [if_pos <| lt_trans hi.1 hk]
        rw [if_pos hi.2, WithTop.coe_eq_coe, ← MvPolynomial.equiv_def']
        exact hk2 i hi.1
      by_cases klt' : k < T.length
      · simpa [min_eq_left_of_lt klt', hk, klt'] using MvPolynomial.lt_def'.mp hk1
      have : T.length ≤ k := Nat.le_of_not_lt klt'
      simp [min_eq_right_iff.mpr this, lt_of_le_of_lt this hk]
    refine ⟨T.length, fun i hi ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [lt_trans hi hlen, hi] using MvPolynomial.equiv_def'.mp (heq i hi)
    simp only [hlen, reduceIte, lt_self_iff_false, WithTop.coe_lt_top]

name: order_eq_iff
statement:
theorem order_eq_iff : S.order = T.order ↔ S.length = T.length ∧ ∀ k, S k ≈ T k where
  mp h
proof:
:= by
    rw [order_def, order_def] at h
    have h := funext_iff.mp h
    have tles := h S.length
    have slet := h T.length
    simp only [lt_self_iff_false, reduceIte, right_eq_ite_iff, WithTop.top_ne_coe, imp_false,
      not_lt, ite_eq_right_iff, WithTop.coe_ne_top] at tles slet
    have ltheq := eq_of_le_of_ge slet tles
    refine ⟨ltheq, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
    by_cases ilt : i < T.length
    · have := h i
      simp only [ltheq, ilt, reduceIte, WithTop.coe_eq_coe] at this
      exact MvPolynomial.equiv_def'.mpr this
    have t0 : T i = 0 := eq_zero_iff_length_le.mp <| Nat.le_of_not_lt ilt
    have s0 : S i = 0 := eq_zero_iff_length_le.mp <| Nat.le_of_not_lt <| ltheq ▸ ilt
    rw [t0, s0]
  mpr h := by
    rw [order_def, order_def, h.1]
    funext i
    split_ifs with ilt
    · rw [WithTop.coe_eq_coe]
      exact MvPolynomial.equiv_def'.mp <| h.2 i
    rfl

name: order_le_iff
statement:
theorem order_le_iff : S.order ≤ T.order ↔ (∃ k < S.length, S k < T k ∧ ∀ i < k, S i ≈ T i) ∨
    (T.length ≤ S.length ∧ ∀ k < T.length, S k ≤ T k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Iff.trans le_iff_lt_or_eq (or_congr order_lt_iff order_eq_iff), or_assoc]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ Or.elim h Or.inl (fun h ↦ Or.inr <| Or.elim h
      (fun h ↦ ⟨le_of_lt h.1, fun k hk ↦ (MvPolynomial.equiv_def''.mp <| h.2 k hk).1⟩)
      (fun h ↦ ⟨ge_of_eq h.1, fun k hk ↦ (MvPolynomial.equiv_def''.mp <| h.2 k).1⟩)),
    fun h ↦ Or.elim h Or.inl (fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ ↦ ?_)⟩
  by_cases h : ∃ k < S.length, S k < T k ∧ ∀ i < k, S i ≈ T i
  · exact Or.inl h
  have h2 : ∀ k < T.length, S k ≈ T k := by
    contrapose! h
    let ⟨k, ⟨hk1, hk2⟩, hk3⟩ := Nat.findX h
    rw [MvPolynomial.equiv_def, not_and', MvPolynomial.not_lt_iff_ge, not_not] at hk2
    exact ⟨k, lt_of_lt_of_le hk1 h1, hk2 <| h2 k hk1,
      fun i hi ↦ not_not.mp <| not_and.mp (hk3 _ hi) <| lt_trans hi hk1⟩
  refine Or.inr <| Or.elim (lt_or_eq_of_le h1)
    (fun h ↦ Or.inl ⟨h, h2⟩)
    (fun h ↦ Or.inr ⟨h.symm, fun k ↦ if hk : k < T.length then (h2 k hk) else by
      rw [eq_zero_iff_length_le.mp <| le_of_not_gt hk,
        eq_zero_iff_length_le.mp <| le_of_not_gt <| h ▸ hk]⟩)

name: le_def'
statement: theorem le_def' : S ≤ T ↔ S.order ≤ T.order
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: le_def
statement:
theorem le_def : S ≤ T ↔ (∃ k < S.length, S k < T k ∧ ∀ i < k, S i ≈ T i) ∨
    (T.length ≤ S.length ∧ ∀ k < T.length, S k ≤ T k)
proof: := order_le_iff

name: lt_def'
statement: theorem lt_def' : S < T ↔ S.order < T.order
proof:
:= Iff.trans lt_iff_le_not_ge (by
  rw [le_def', le_def', not_le]
  exact and_iff_right_iff_imp.mpr le_of_lt)

name: lt_def
statement:
theorem lt_def : S < T ↔ (∃ k < S.length, S k < T k ∧ ∀ i < k, S i ≈ T i) ∨
    (T.length < S.length ∧ ∀ i < T.length, S i ≈ T i)
proof: := Iff.trans lt_def' order_lt_iff

name: lt_empty
statement: theorem lt_empty : S ≠ ∅ → S < ∅
proof:
:= fun h ↦ lt_def.mpr <| Or.inr
  ⟨by rw [length_empty]; exact length_ge_one_iff.mpr h,
  fun i hi ↦ by rw [length_empty] at hi; exact absurd hi <| Nat.not_lt_zero i⟩

name: le_empty
statement: theorem le_empty (S : TriangularSet σ R) : S ≤ ∅
proof:
:=
  Or.elim (eq_or_ne S ∅) le_of_eq <| le_of_lt ∘ lt_empty

name: not_lt_iff_ge
statement: @[simp] theorem not_lt_iff_ge : ¬(S < T) ↔ T ≤ S
proof: := by rw [le_def', lt_def']; exact not_lt

name: not_le_iff_gt
statement: @[simp] theorem not_le_iff_gt : ¬(S ≤ T) ↔ T < S
proof: := by rw [le_def', lt_def']; exact not_le

name: ge_of_forall_equiv
statement: theorem ge_of_forall_equiv : (∀ n < S.length, ∃ i < T.length, T i ≈ S n) → T ≤ S
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  contrapose! h
  match lt_def.mp <| not_le_iff_gt.mp h with
  | .inl ⟨k, hk1, hk2, hk3⟩ =>
    refine ⟨k, hk1, fun i hi1 ↦ ?_⟩
    match Nat.lt_trichotomy i k with
    | .inl hi2 =>
      apply not_antisymmRel_of_lt
      rw [AntisymmRel.lt_congr_left <| Setoid.symm <| hk3 i hi2]
      exact apply_lt_of_index_lt hk1 hi2
    | .inr hi2 => match hi2 with
    | .inl hi2 => exact not_antisymmRel_of_gt (hi2 ▸ hk2)
    | .inr hi2 => exact not_antisymmRel_of_gt <| lt_trans hk2 <| apply_lt_of_index_lt hi1 hi2
  | .inr ⟨h1, h2⟩ =>
    refine ⟨T.length, h1, fun i hi1 ↦ ?_⟩
    apply not_antisymmRel_of_lt
    rw [AntisymmRel.lt_congr_left <| Setoid.symm <| h2 i hi1]
    exact apply_lt_of_index_lt h1 hi1

name: ge_of_subset
statement: theorem ge_of_subset : S ⊆ T → T ≤ S
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  ge_of_forall_equiv fun n hn ↦
    have ⟨i, hi1, hi2⟩ : S n ∈ T := h <| apply_mem hn
    ⟨i, hi1, by rw [hi2]⟩

name: equiv_def''
statement: theorem equiv_def'' : S ≈ T ↔ S ≤ T ∧ T ≤ S
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: equiv_def'
statement: theorem equiv_def' : S ≈ T ↔ S.order = T.order
proof:
:= Iff.trans equiv_def''
  (by rw [le_def', le_def']; exact Std.le_antisymm_iff)

name: equiv_def
statement: theorem equiv_def : S ≈ T ↔ ¬S < T ∧ ¬T < S
proof:
:= Iff.trans equiv_def''
  (by rw [not_lt_iff_ge, not_lt_iff_ge, and_comm])

name: equiv_iff
statement: theorem equiv_iff : S ≈ T ↔ S.length = T.length ∧ (∀ k, S k ≈ T k)
proof:
:=
  Iff.trans equiv_def' order_eq_iff

name: equiv_iff'
statement: theorem equiv_iff' : S ≈ T ↔ S.length = T.length ∧ (∀ k < S.length, S k ≈ T k)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [equiv_iff, and_congr_right_iff]
  refine fun h1 ↦ ⟨fun h2 k _ ↦ h2 k, fun h2 k ↦ ?_⟩
  if hk : k < S.length then exact h2 k hk
  else
    have : S.length ≤ k := Nat.le_of_not_lt hk
    rw [eq_zero_iff_length_le.mp this, eq_zero_iff_length_le.mp (h1 ▸ this)]

name: le_iff_lt_or_equiv
statement: theorem le_iff_lt_or_equiv : S ≤ T ↔ S < T ∨ S ≈ T
proof: := le_iff_lt_or_antisymmRel

name: lt_of_equiv_of_lt
statement: theorem lt_of_equiv_of_lt {U : TriangularSet σ R} : S ≈ T → T < U → S < U
proof:
:=
  lt_of_antisymmRel_of_lt

name: lt_of_lt_of_equiv
statement: theorem lt_of_lt_of_equiv {U : TriangularSet σ R} : S < T → T ≈ U → S < U
proof:
:=
  lt_of_lt_of_antisymmRel

name: equiv_of_le_of_ge
statement: theorem equiv_of_le_of_ge : S ≤ T → T ≤ S → S ≈ T
proof: := And.intro

name: gt_of_ssubset
statement: theorem gt_of_ssubset : S ⊂ T → T < S
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  have := Set.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mp h
  apply or_iff_not_imp_right.mp <|  le_iff_lt_or_equiv.mp <| ge_of_subset this.1
  refine Not.intro fun con ↦ absurd (length_lt_of_ssubset h) ?_
  exact not_lt_of_ge <| le_of_eq (equiv_iff.mp con).1

name: lt_take
statement: theorem lt_take : n < S.length → S < S.take n
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  lt_def.mpr <| Or.inr ⟨S.length_take n ▸ inf_lt_of_left_lt h,
  fun i hi ↦ by rw [take_apply, if_pos (min_eq_left_of_lt h ▸ length_take S n ▸ hi)]⟩

name: lt_drop
statement: theorem lt_drop : S ≠ ∅ → 0 < n → S < S.drop n
proof:
:= fun h1 h2 ↦
  if gel : S.length ≤ n then drop_eq_empty_of_ge_length gel ▸ lt_empty h1
  else lt_def.mpr <| Or.inl ⟨0, length_gt_zero_iff.mpr h1, by
      rw [drop_apply, add_zero]
      apply MvPolynomial.lt_of_max_vars_lt
      exact max_vars_lt_of_index_lt (Nat.lt_of_not_le gel) h2,
    fun i hi ↦ absurd hi <| Nat.not_lt_zero i⟩

name: concat_lt
statement: theorem concat_lt {p : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : S.CanConcat p) : S.concat p h < S
proof:
:= lt_def.mpr <|
  Or.inr ⟨length_concat h ▸ lt_add_one S.length, fun i hi ↦ by rw [concat_apply h, if_pos hi]⟩

name: single_lt_empty
statement: theorem single_lt_empty [DecidableEq R] : p ≠ 0 → (single p) < ∅
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ lt_empty <| (not_iff_not.mpr single_eq_zero_iff).mp h

name: gt_single_of_first_gt
statement: theorem gt_single_of_first_gt [DecidableEq R] : p ≠ 0 → p < S 0 → single p < S
proof:
:= fun hp hs ↦
  lt_def.mpr <| Or.inl ⟨0,
    Nat.lt_of_sub_eq_succ <| length_single hp,
    (single_apply_zero p).symm ▸ hs,
    fun i hi ↦ absurd hi <| Nat.not_lt_zero i⟩

name: wellFoundedLT_mvPolynomial_of_wellFoundedLT
statement:
theorem wellFoundedLT_mvPolynomial_of_wellFoundedLT :
    WellFoundedLT (TriangularSet σ R) → WellFoundedLT (MvPolynomial σ R)
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  rw [WellFoundedLT, isWellFounded_iff, wellFounded_iff_isEmpty_descending_chain] at h ⊢
  contrapose! h
  rcases nonempty_subtype.mp h with ⟨f, hf1⟩
  have hf2 (n : ℕ) : f n ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra con
    absurd con ▸ (hf1 n)
    exact MvPolynomial.not_lt_iff_ge.mpr MvPolynomial.zero_le
  use fun n ↦ single' (hf2 n)
  intro n
  refine lt_def.mpr <| Or.inl ⟨0, ?_⟩
  simpa [length_single'] using hf1 n

name: wellFoundedLT_variables_of_wellFoundedLT
statement:
theorem wellFoundedLT_variables_of_wellFoundedLT [Nontrivial R] :
    WellFoundedLT (TriangularSet σ R) → WellFoundedLT σ
proof:
:=
  MvPolynomial.wellFoundedLT_variables_of_wellFoundedLT ∘
    wellFoundedLT_mvPolynomial_of_wellFoundedLT

name: wellFoundedGT_variables_of_wellFoundedLT
statement:
theorem wellFoundedGT_variables_of_wellFoundedLT [Nontrivial R] :
    WellFoundedLT (TriangularSet σ R) → WellFoundedGT σ
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  rw [WellFoundedGT, isWellFounded_iff, wellFounded_iff_isEmpty_descending_chain]
  rw [WellFoundedLT, isWellFounded_iff, wellFounded_iff_isEmpty_descending_chain] at h
  contrapose! h
  rcases nonempty_subtype.mp h with ⟨f, hf1⟩
  have hf2 (n : ℕ) : (MvPolynomial.X (f n) : MvPolynomial σ R) < MvPolynomial.X (f (n + 1)) :=
    MvPolynomial.X_lt_of_lt <| hf1 n
  let S (n : ℕ) : TriangularSet σ R := {
    toList := List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n ↦ MvPolynomial.X (f i.1))
    zero_notMem' := by simp only [List.mem_ofFn, X_ne_zero, exists_false, not_false_eq_true]
    isChain_max_vars' := List.isChain_iff_getElem.mpr fun i hi ↦ by
      simpa only [List.getElem_ofFn, vars_X, Finset.max_singleton, WithBot.coe_lt_coe] using hf1 i}
  have length_S (n : ℕ) : (S n).length = n := List.length_ofFn
  have S_apply (n i : ℕ) : S n i = if i < n then MvPolynomial.X (f i) else 0 := by
    rw [← (S n).toList_getElem?_getD]
    aesop
  refine ⟨S, fun n ↦ lt_def.mpr <| Or.inr ?_⟩
  simp only [length_S, lt_add_iff_pos_right, zero_lt_one, S_apply, true_and]
  intro i hi
  simp only [Nat.lt_add_right 1 hi, ↓reduceIte, hi, Setoid.refl]

name: length_le
statement: theorem length_le [Fintype σ] : S.length ≤ Fintype.card σ + 1
proof:
:= by
  let f : Fin S.length → WithBot σ := fun i ↦ (S i).vars.max
  have : f.Injective :=
    fun ⟨_, hi⟩ ⟨_, hj⟩ h ↦ Fin.mk.injEq _ hi _ hj ▸ index_eq_of_max_vars_eq hi hj h
  have card_le := Fintype.card_le_of_injective f this
  have : Fintype.card (WithBot σ) = Fintype.card (Option σ) := rfl
  rw [Fintype.card_fin, this, Fintype.card_option] at card_le
  exact card_le

name: _order_def
statement: private theorem _order_def [Fintype σ] : S._order = fun i ↦ S.order i.1
proof: := rfl

name: _order_lt_iff
statement:
private theorem _order_lt_iff [Fintype σ] : S._order < T._order ↔ S.order < T.order where
  mp h
proof:
:= by
    rw [Pi.instLTLexForall] at h ⊢
    rw [_order_def, _order_def] at h
    simp only [Pi.Lex] at h
    rcases h with ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩
    have kn : k < Fintype.card σ + 1 := Decidable.byContradiction fun con ↦ by
      simp only [order_apply' <| le_trans length_le <| Nat.le_of_not_lt con] at hk2
      exact (lt_self_iff_false ⊤).mp hk2
    exact Exists.intro k.1 ⟨fun i hi ↦ hk1 ⟨i, lt_trans hi kn⟩ hi, hk2⟩
  mpr h := by
    rw [Pi.instLTLexForall] at h ⊢
    rw [_order_def, _order_def] at ⊢
    simp only [Pi.Lex] at h
    rcases h with ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩
    have kn : k < Fintype.card σ + 1 := Decidable.byContradiction fun con ↦ by
      simp only [order_apply' <| le_trans length_le <| Nat.le_of_not_lt con] at hk2
      exact (lt_self_iff_false ⊤).mp hk2
    exact Exists.intro ⟨k, kn⟩ ⟨fun _ hi ↦ hk1 _ hi, hk2⟩

name: Set.has_min
statement: theorem Set.has_min (h : S'.Nonempty) : ∃ S ∈ S', ∀ T ∈ S', S ≤ T
proof:
:=
  haveI : WellFounded (· < ·) := @wellFounded_lt (TriangularSet σ R) _ _
  have ⟨S, hS1, hS2⟩ := WellFounded.has_min this S' h
  ⟨S, hS1, fun T hT ↦ not_lt_iff_ge.mp (hS2 T hT)⟩

name: Set.min_mem
statement: theorem Set.min_mem (h : S'.Nonempty) : min S' h ∈ S'
proof:
:=
  (Exists.choose_spec (has_min S' h)).1

name: Set.min_le
statement: theorem Set.min_le (h : S'.Nonempty) : ∀ T ∈ S', min S' h ≤ T
proof:
:=
  (Exists.choose_spec (has_min S' h)).2

name: ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext (h : ∀ i, S i = T i) : S = T
proof: := DFunLike.ext _ _ h

name: ne_zero_iff_lt_length
statement: theorem ne_zero_iff_lt_length : n < S.length ↔ S n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  change n < S.toList.length ↔ S.toList[n]?.getD 0 ≠ 0
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ by grind⟩
  have : S.toList[n]?.isSome := by aesop
  rcases Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp this with ⟨p, hp⟩
  suffices p ≠ 0 from hp ▸ this
  intro hp2
  absurd hp2 ▸ S.zero_notMem'
  exact List.mem_of_getElem? hp

name: eq_zero_iff_length_le
statement: theorem eq_zero_iff_length_le : S.length ≤ n ↔ S n = 0
proof:
:=
  not_iff_not.mp <| Iff.trans Nat.not_le ne_zero_iff_lt_length

name: ext'
statement: theorem ext' (h1 : S.length = T.length) (h2 : ∀ i < S.length, S i = T i) : S = T
proof:
:= ext fun i ↦ by
  if h : i < S.length then exact h2 i h
  else
    have h := le_of_not_gt h
    rw [eq_zero_iff_length_le.mp h, eq_zero_iff_length_le.mp <| h1 ▸ h]

name: apply_length_eq_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem apply_length_eq_zero : S S.length = 0
proof: := eq_zero_iff_length_le.mp (le_refl _)

name: toList_getElem
statement: theorem toList_getElem?_getD : S.toList[n]?.getD 0 = S n
proof: := rfl

name: toList_getElem
statement: theorem toList_getElem {n : ℕ} (h : n < S.length) : S.toList[n] = S n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toList_getElem?_getD]
  change n < S.toList.length at h
  aesop

name: length_toList
statement: @[simp] theorem length_toList (S : TriangularSet σ R) : S.toList.length = S.length
proof: := rfl

name: toList_eq_iff_eq
statement: @[simp] theorem toList_eq_iff_eq : S.toList = T.toList ↔ S = T
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ h ▸ rfl⟩
  cases S; cases T
  congr

name: mem_toList_iff'
statement: theorem mem_toList_iff' : p ∈ S.toList ↔ ∃ n < S.length, S n = p
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.mem_iff_getElem]
  constructor
  repeat'
  rintro ⟨n, hn1, hn2⟩
  use n, hn1
  exact toList_getElem hn1 ▸ hn2

name: zero_notMem_toList
statement: theorem zero_notMem_toList (S : TriangularSet σ R) : 0 ∉ S.toList
proof: := S.zero_notMem'

name: toList_non_zero
statement: theorem toList_non_zero (S : TriangularSet σ R) : ∀ ⦃p⦄, p ∈ S.toList → p ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun _ hp ↦ by
  have := zero_notMem_toList S
  exact ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hp this

name: toList_isChain
statement: theorem toList_isChain (S : TriangularSet σ R) : S.toList.IsChain (·.vars.max < ·.vars.max)
proof:
:=
  S.isChain_max_vars'

name: toList_pairwise
statement: theorem toList_pairwise (S : TriangularSet σ R) : S.toList.Pairwise (·.vars.max < ·.vars.max)
proof:
:= by
  apply (@List.isChain_iff_pairwise _ _ _ ?_).mp S.toList_isChain
  apply Trans.mk
  intro p q r hpq hqr
  exact lt_trans hpq hqr

name: max_vars_lt_next
statement: theorem max_vars_lt_next (h : n < S.length - 1) : (S n).vars.max < (S (n + 1)).vars.max
proof:
:= by
  have hn : n < S.length := Nat.lt_of_lt_pred h
  have hn1 : n + 1 < S.length := Nat.add_lt_of_lt_sub h
  rw [← toList_getElem hn, ← toList_getElem hn1]
  exact List.isChain_iff_getElem.mp S.toList_isChain n hn1

name: max_vars_lt_next'
statement:
theorem max_vars_lt_next' :
    n + 1 < S.length → (S n).vars.max < (S (n + 1)).vars.max
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ max_vars_lt_next <| Nat.lt_sub_of_add_lt h

name: max_vars_lt_next''
statement:
theorem max_vars_lt_next'' :
    0 < n → n < S.length → (S (n - 1)).vars.max < (S n).vars.max
proof:
:= fun h1 h2 ↦
  have : n - 1 < S.length - 1 := Nat.sub_lt_sub_right h1 h2
  Nat.sub_add_cancel h1 ▸ max_vars_lt_next this

name: max_vars_lt_of_index_lt
statement:
theorem max_vars_lt_of_index_lt (h : n < S.length) :
    m < n → (S m).vars.max < (S n).vars.max
proof:
:= fun hmn ↦ by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact absurd hmn <| Nat.not_lt_zero m
  | succ n hn => match Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hmn with
    | Or.inl hmn =>
      exact lt_trans (hn (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt h) hmn) <| max_vars_lt_next' h
    | Or.inr hmn => rw [hmn]; exact max_vars_lt_next' h

name: index_lt_of_max_vars_lt
statement:
theorem index_lt_of_max_vars_lt (h : m < S.length) :
    (S m).vars.max < (S n).vars.max → m < n
proof:
:= fun hs ↦
  Decidable.byContradiction fun hmn ↦ False.elim <| match Nat.eq_or_lt_of_not_lt hmn with
    | Or.inl hmn => Eq.not_lt (congrArg (fun i ↦ (S i).vars.max) hmn) hs
    | Or.inr hmn => (not_lt.mpr <| le_of_lt hs) (max_vars_lt_of_index_lt h hmn)

name: false_of_max_vars_ge_of_index_lt
statement:
theorem false_of_max_vars_ge_of_index_lt :
    m < n → n < S.length → (S n).vars.max ≤ (S m).vars.max → False
proof:
:=
  fun h1 h2 h3 ↦ absurd h3 <| not_le_of_gt <| max_vars_lt_of_index_lt h2 h1

name: max_vars_le_of_index_le
statement:
theorem max_vars_le_of_index_le :
    m ≤ n → n < S.length → (S m).vars.max ≤ (S n).vars.max
proof:
:= fun hmn h ↦
  Or.elim (lt_or_eq_of_le hmn)
    (fun hmn ↦ le_of_lt <| max_vars_lt_of_index_lt h hmn)
    (fun hmn ↦ by simp only [hmn, le_refl])

name: index_eq_of_max_vars_eq
statement:
theorem index_eq_of_max_vars_eq :
    m < S.length → n < S.length → (S m).vars.max = (S n).vars.max → m = n
proof:
:=
  fun hm hn hc ↦ Decidable.byContradiction fun con ↦ by
    match Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne con with
    | Or.inl con => exact absurd hc <| ne_of_lt <| max_vars_lt_of_index_lt hn con
    | Or.inr con => exact absurd hc.symm <| ne_of_lt <| max_vars_lt_of_index_lt hm con

name: index_eq_of_apply_eq
statement: theorem index_eq_of_apply_eq : m < S.length → n < S.length → S m = S n → m = n
proof:
:=
  fun hm hn hc ↦ index_eq_of_max_vars_eq hm hn (congrArg (·.vars.max) hc)

name: index_eq_zero_of_max_vars_eq_bot
statement:
theorem index_eq_zero_of_max_vars_eq_bot :
    n < S.length → (S n).vars.max = ⊥ → n = 0
proof:
:= fun h1 h2 ↦
  Decidable.byContradiction fun hn ↦
    WithBot.not_lt_bot _ (h2 ▸ max_vars_lt_next'' (Nat.zero_lt_of_ne_zero hn) h1)

name: exists_index_max_vars_between_of_max_vars_first_lt
statement:
theorem exists_index_max_vars_between_of_max_vars_first_lt
    (h : (S 0).vars.max < p.vars.max) : ∃ k ≤ S.length,
    (S (k - 1)).vars.max < p.vars.max ∧
    (p.vars.max ≤ (S k).vars.max ∨ k = S.length)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra con
  simp only [not_exists, not_and, not_or, not_le] at con
  have : ∀ k ≤ S.length, (S k).vars.max < p.vars.max := fun k hk ↦ by
    induction k with
    | zero => exact h
    | succ k hk' => exact (con (k + 1) hk <| hk' <| Nat.le_of_succ_le hk).1
  have con := con S.length <| le_refl S.length
  have := this (S.length - 1) <| Nat.sub_le S.length 1
  exact (con this).2 rfl

name: toList_nodup
statement: theorem toList_nodup (S : TriangularSet σ R) : S.toList.Nodup
proof:
:= by
  refine List.nodup_iff_injective_getElem.mpr ?_
  intro ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩ (h : S.toList[i] = S.toList[j])
  rw [toList_getElem, toList_getElem] at h
  exact (Fin.mk.injEq ..) ▸ index_eq_of_apply_eq hi hj h

name: mem_def
statement: theorem mem_def : p ∈ S ↔ ∃ n < S.length, S n = p
proof: := Eq.to_iff rfl

name: mem_toList_iff
statement: @[simp] theorem mem_toList_iff : p ∈ S.toList ↔ p ∈ S
proof: := mem_toList_iff'

name: zero_notMem
statement: @[simp] theorem zero_notMem (S : TriangularSet σ R) : 0 ∉ S
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  absurd (mem_toList_iff.mpr h) S.zero_notMem_toList

name: ne_zero_of_mem
statement: theorem ne_zero_of_mem : p ∈ S → p ≠ 0
proof: := fun h1 h2 ↦ (h2 ▸ zero_notMem S) h1

name: apply_mem
statement: theorem apply_mem {n : ℕ} : n < S.length → S n ∈ S
proof: := fun h ↦ ⟨n, h, rfl⟩

name: forall_mem_iff_forall_index
statement:
theorem forall_mem_iff_forall_index {S : TriangularSet σ R} {a : MvPolynomial σ R → Prop} :
    (∀ p ∈ S, a p) ↔ ∀ i < S.length, a (S i)
proof: := Set.forall_mem_image

name: forall_mem_iff_forall_index'
statement:
theorem forall_mem_iff_forall_index' {S : TriangularSet σ R} {a : MvPolynomial σ R → Prop} {n : ℕ}
    (h : n = S.length) : (∀ p ∈ S, a p) ↔ ∀ i : Fin n, a (S i)
proof:
:=
  Iff.trans forall_mem_iff_forall_index (by rw [Fin.forall_iff, h])

name: exists_mem_iff_exists_index
statement:
theorem exists_mem_iff_exists_index {S : TriangularSet σ R} {a : MvPolynomial σ R → Prop} :
    (∃ p ∈ S, a p) ↔ ∃ i < S.length, a (S i)
proof: := Set.exists_mem_image

name: exists_mem_iff_exists_index'
statement:
theorem exists_mem_iff_exists_index' {S : TriangularSet σ R} {a : MvPolynomial σ R → Prop} {n : ℕ}
    (h : n = S.length) : (∃ p ∈ S, a p) ↔ ∃ i : Fin n, a (S i)
proof:
:=
  Iff.trans exists_mem_iff_exists_index (by simp only [Fin.exists_iff, h, exists_prop])

name: Subset.refl
statement: @[simp] theorem Subset.refl (S : TriangularSet σ R) : S ⊆ S
proof: := fun _ ↦ id

name: Subset.trans
statement: theorem Subset.trans {U : TriangularSet σ R} : S ⊆ T → T ⊆ U → S ⊆ U
proof:
:=
  fun h₁ h₂ _ m => h₂ (h₁ m)

name: subset_def
statement: theorem subset_def : S ⊆ T ↔ ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ S → x ∈ T
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: mem_of_subset
statement: theorem mem_of_subset (p : MvPolynomial σ R) (h : S ⊆ T) : p ∈ S → p ∈ T

name: ssubset_def
statement: theorem ssubset_def : S ⊂ T ↔ S ⊆ T ∧ ¬T ⊆ S
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: card_toFinset
statement: @[simp] theorem card_toFinset (S : TriangularSet σ R) : S.toFinset.card = S.length
proof:
:= by
  simp [toFinset]

name: mem_toFinset_iff
statement: @[simp] theorem mem_toFinset_iff : p ∈ S.toFinset ↔ p ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  refine Iff.trans ?_ SetLike.mem_coe
  simp [toFinset, SetLike.coe, Fin.exists_iff, toList_getElem]

name: toFinset_eq_iff_eq
statement: @[simp] theorem toFinset_eq_iff_eq : S.toFinset = T.toFinset ↔ S = T
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ SetLike.ext fun p ↦ ?_, congrArg _⟩
  rw [← mem_toFinset_iff, ← mem_toFinset_iff]
  aesop

name: toFinset_eq_coe_set
statement: theorem toFinset_eq_coe_set (S : TriangularSet σ R) : S.toFinset = (S : Set (MvPolynomial σ R))
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun _ ↦ ⟨SetLike.mem_coe.mpr ∘ mem_toFinset_iff.mp, mem_toFinset_iff.mpr⟩

name: length_le_of_subset
statement: theorem length_le_of_subset : S ⊆ T → S.length ≤ T.length
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  rw [← card_toFinset, ← card_toFinset]
  exact Finset.card_le_card <| Finset.coe_subset.mp (by simpa [toFinset_eq_coe_set] using h)

name: length_lt_of_ssubset
statement: theorem length_lt_of_ssubset : S ⊂ T → S.length < T.length
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  rw [← card_toFinset, ← card_toFinset]
  exact Finset.card_lt_card <| Finset.coe_ssubset.mp (by simpa [toFinset_eq_coe_set] using h)

name: empty_eq_default
statement: theorem empty_eq_default : (∅ : TriangularSet σ R) = default
proof: := rfl

name: toList_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem toList_empty : (∅ : TriangularSet σ R).toList = []
proof: := rfl

name: length_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem length_empty : (∅ : TriangularSet σ R).length = 0
proof: := rfl

name: empty_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem empty_apply : (∅ : TriangularSet σ R) n = 0
proof: := rfl

name: length_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem length_eq_zero_iff : S.length = 0 ↔ S = ∅
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ext fun i ↦ eq_zero_iff_length_le.mp <| h ▸ Nat.zero_le i, fun h ↦ h ▸ length_empty⟩

name: length_gt_zero_iff
statement: theorem length_gt_zero_iff : 0 < S.length ↔ S ≠ ∅
proof:
:=
  iff_not_comm.mp <| Iff.trans length_eq_zero_iff.symm
    ⟨fun h ↦ h ▸ Nat.not_add_one_le_zero 0, Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos⟩

name: length_ge_one_iff
statement: theorem length_ge_one_iff : 1 ≤ S.length ↔ S ≠ ∅
proof: := length_gt_zero_iff

name: notMem_empty
statement: theorem notMem_empty (p : MvPolynomial σ R) : p ∉ (∅ : TriangularSet σ R)
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  Nat.not_succ_le_zero _ (Exists.choose_spec h).1

name: eq_empty_of_forall_notMem
statement: theorem eq_empty_of_forall_notMem : (∀ p, p ∉ S) → S = ∅
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  contrapose! h
  exact ⟨S 0, apply_mem <| length_gt_zero_iff.mpr h⟩

name: toList_single'
statement: theorem toList_single' (hp : p ≠ 0) : (single' hp).toList = [p]
proof: := rfl

name: single'_apply
statement:
theorem single'_apply (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    (single' hp) n = if n = 0 then p else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toList_getElem?_getD, toList_single' hp, List.getElem?_singleton]
  apply apply_ite_left

name: length_single'
statement: theorem length_single' (hp : p ≠ 0) : (single' hp).length = 1
proof: := rfl

name: toList_take
statement: theorem toList_take (S : TriangularSet σ R) (n : ℕ) : (S.take n).toList = S.toList.take n
proof: := rfl

name: length_take
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_take (S : TriangularSet σ R) (n : ℕ) : (S.take n).length = n ⊓ S.length
proof:
:=
  List.length_take

name: take_apply
statement:
theorem take_apply (S : TriangularSet σ R) (n m : ℕ) :
    (S.take n) m = if m < n then S m else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toList_getElem?_getD, toList_take, List.getElem?_take]
  apply apply_ite_left

name: take_apply'
statement:
theorem take_apply' {S : TriangularSet σ R} {n m : ℕ} (h : m < n ⊓ S.length) :
    (S.take n) m = S m
proof:
:= by
  rw [take_apply, if_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le h (Nat.min_le_left ..))]

name: take_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem take_zero (S : TriangularSet σ R) : S.take 0 = ∅
proof: := ext fun _ ↦ rfl

name: take_length
statement: @[simp] theorem take_length (S : TriangularSet σ R) : S.take (S.length) = S
proof:
:= ext fun i ↦ by
  rw [take_apply]
  split_ifs with hi
  · exact rfl
  rw [eq_zero_iff_length_le.mp <| Nat.le_of_not_lt hi]

name: take_subset
statement: theorem take_subset (S : TriangularSet σ R) (n : ℕ) : S.take n ⊆ S
proof:
:= fun p hp ↦ by
  rw [← mem_toList_iff] at hp ⊢
  exact List.mem_of_mem_take hp

name: toList_drop
statement: theorem toList_drop (S : TriangularSet σ R) (n : ℕ) : (S.drop n).toList = S.toList.drop n
proof: := rfl

name: length_drop
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_drop (S : TriangularSet σ R) (n : ℕ) : (S.drop n).length = S.length - n
proof:
:=
  List.length_drop

name: drop_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem drop_apply (S : TriangularSet σ R) (n m : ℕ) : (S.drop n) m = S (n + m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toList_getElem?_getD, ← toList_getElem?_getD, toList_drop, List.getElem?_drop]

name: drop_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem drop_zero (S : TriangularSet σ R) : S.drop 0 = S
proof:
:=
  ext fun i ↦ by rw [drop_apply, zero_add]

name: drop_eq_empty_of_ge_length
statement: theorem drop_eq_empty_of_ge_length : S.length ≤ n → S.drop n = ∅
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  ext fun _ ↦ (drop_apply S ..).symm ▸ eq_zero_iff_length_le.mp (Nat.le_add_right_of_le h)

name: drop_length
statement: @[simp] theorem drop_length (S : TriangularSet σ R) : S.drop S.length = ∅
proof:
:=
  drop_eq_empty_of_ge_length (le_refl _)

name: canConcat_def
statement:
theorem canConcat_def : S.CanConcat p ↔
    (p ≠ 0 ∧ (0 < S.length → (S (S.length - 1)).vars.max < p.vars.max))
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: empty_canConcat
statement: theorem empty_canConcat : p ≠ 0 → (∅ : TriangularSet σ R).CanConcat p
proof:
:=
  fun h1 ↦ ⟨h1, fun h2 ↦ absurd h2 <| Nat.lt_irrefl 0⟩

name: not_canConcat_zero
statement: theorem not_canConcat_zero : ¬ S.CanConcat 0
proof: := not_and.mpr fun a _ ↦ a rfl

name: toList_concat
statement:
theorem toList_concat {p : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : S.CanConcat p) :
    (S.concat p).toList = S.toList.concat p
proof: := rfl

name: length_concat
statement:
@[simp] theorem length_concat {p : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : S.CanConcat p) :
    (S.concat p).length = S.length + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← length_toList, ← length_toList, toList_concat, List.length_concat]

name: concat_apply
statement:
theorem concat_apply {p : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : S.CanConcat p) (n : ℕ) :
    (S.concat p) n = if n < S.length then S n else if n = S.length then p else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toList_getElem?_getD]
  grind [= toList_concat, = toList_getElem?_getD, = length_toList]

name: concat_apply_length
statement:
theorem concat_apply_length {p : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : S.CanConcat p) :
    (S.concat p) S.length = p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [concat_apply, lt_self_iff_false, ↓reduceIte]

name: mem_concat
statement: theorem mem_concat {p : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : S.CanConcat p) : p ∈ S.concat p
proof:
:= by
  use S.length
  rw [length_concat, concat_apply h, if_neg (Nat.lt_irrefl S.length), if_pos rfl]
  simp only [lt_add_iff_pos_right, zero_lt_one, and_self]

name: subset_concat
statement: theorem subset_concat {p : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : S.CanConcat p) : S ⊆ S.concat p
proof:
:= fun _ ⟨i, hi⟩ ↦
  ⟨i, (length_concat h) ▸ Nat.lt_add_one_of_lt hi.1, (concat_apply h _) ▸ if_pos hi.1 ▸ hi.2⟩

name: mem_concat_iff
statement:
theorem mem_concat_iff {p q : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : S.CanConcat p) :
    q ∈ S.concat p ↔ q = p ∨ q ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_toList_iff, toList_concat, List.concat_eq_append, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton,
    mem_toList_iff, Or.comm]

name: coe_concat_eq_insert
statement:
theorem coe_concat_eq_insert {p : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : S.CanConcat p) :
    S.concat p = (S : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)).insert p
proof:
:= Set.ext fun q ↦ by
  simpa using mem_concat_iff h

name: single_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem single_zero : single (0 : MvPolynomial σ R) = ∅
proof: := rfl

name: length_single
statement: theorem length_single : p ≠ 0 → (single p).length = 1
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ by simp only [single, h, reduceDIte]; exact rfl

name: single_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem single_eq_zero_iff : p = 0 ↔ single p = ∅
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ by simp only [single, h, reduceDIte],
  fun h ↦ by by_contra con; absurd h ▸ length_single con; exact Nat.ne_of_beq_eq_false rfl⟩

name: length_single_zero
statement: theorem length_single_zero : p = 0 → (single p).length = 0
proof: := fun h ↦ single_eq_zero_iff.mp h ▸ rfl

name: length_single_le_one
statement: theorem length_single_le_one : (single p).length ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  Or.elim (em (p = 0))
    (fun h ↦ le_of_eq_of_le (length_single_zero h) <| Nat.zero_le 1)
    (fun h ↦ (length_single h).symm ▸ le_refl 1)

name: single_apply_zero
statement: theorem single_apply_zero (p : MvPolynomial σ R) : single p 0 = p
proof:
:=
  Or.elim (em (p = 0))
    (fun h ↦ by simp only [single, h, reduceDIte, empty_apply])
    (fun h ↦ by simp only [single, h, reduceDIte, single'_apply h, reduceIte])

name: single_apply_nonzero
statement: theorem single_apply_nonzero (p : MvPolynomial σ R) : n ≠ 0 → single p n = 0
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ Or.elim (em (p = 0))
    (fun hn ↦ by simp only [single, hn, reduceDIte, empty_apply])
    (fun hn ↦ by simp only [single, hn, reduceDIte, single'_apply hn, reduceIte, h])

name: mem_single_of_ne_zero
statement: theorem mem_single_of_ne_zero : p ≠ 0 → p ∈ single p
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  mem_def.mpr ⟨0, length_single h ▸ Nat.one_pos, single_apply_zero p⟩

name: notMem_single_of_ne
statement: theorem notMem_single_of_ne {q : MvPolynomial σ R} : q ≠ p → q ∉ single p
proof:
:= mt fun h ↦
  have ⟨_, hi1, hi2⟩ := h
  have hi1 := Nat.lt_one_iff.mp <| lt_of_lt_of_le hi1 length_single_le_one
  (single_apply_zero p) ▸ hi1 ▸ hi2.symm

name: single_of_length_le_one
statement: theorem single_of_length_le_one : S.length ≤ 1 → S = single (S 0)
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ ext fun i ↦ by
    match Decidable.em (i = 0) with
    | Or.inl hi => rw [hi, single_apply_zero]
    | Or.inr hi =>
      have : S.length ≤ i := Nat.le_trans h <| Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hi
      rw [eq_zero_iff_length_le.mp this, single_apply_nonzero _ hi]

name: single_of_last_max_vars_eq_bot
statement:
theorem single_of_last_max_vars_eq_bot :
    (S (S.length - 1)).vars.max = ⊥ → S = single (S 0)
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  have : S.length ≤ 1 := by
    by_cases hl : S.length = 0
    · exact hl ▸ Nat.zero_le 1
    have : S.length - 1 < S.length := Nat.sub_one_lt hl
    exact Nat.le_of_sub_eq_zero <| index_eq_zero_of_max_vars_eq_bot this h
  single_of_length_le_one this

name: takeConcat_eq_concat_of_canConcat
statement: theorem takeConcat_eq_concat_of_canConcat (h : S.CanConcat p) : S.takeConcat p = S.concat p
proof:
:= by
  unfold takeConcat
  split_ifs with h1 hc
  · simp [h1, single, h.1, single', concat]
  repeat' have h1 := length_gt_zero_iff.mpr h1
  · absurd hc
    simp only [not_le]
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt (max_vars_le_of_index_le (Nat.zero_le _) ?_) <| h.2 h1
    exact Nat.sub_one_lt_of_lt h1
  let k := Nat.find <| exists_index_max_vars_between_of_max_vars_first_lt <| lt_of_not_ge hc
  have hk : k = S.length := by
    have : k ≤ S.length ∧ (S (k - 1)).vars.max < p.vars.max ∧
        (p.vars.max ≤ (S k).vars.max ∨ k = S.length) :=
      Nat.find_spec <| exists_index_max_vars_between_of_max_vars_first_lt <| lt_of_not_ge hc
    by_contra con
    simp only [con, or_false] at this
    absurd lt_of_le_of_ne this.1 con
    have := index_lt_of_max_vars_lt (Nat.sub_one_lt_of_lt h1) (lt_of_lt_of_le (h.2 h1) this.2.2)
    exact Nat.not_lt.mpr <| Nat.le_of_pred_lt this
  change (S.take k).concat p _ = S.concat p
  simp only [hk, take_length]

name: takeConcat_zero_eq_empty
statement: theorem takeConcat_zero_eq_empty (S : TriangularSet σ R) : S.takeConcat 0 = ∅
proof:
:= by
  have : (0 : MvPolynomial σ R).vars.max = ⊥ := rfl
  simp only [takeConcat, single_zero, this, bot_le, ↓reduceDIte, ite_self]

name: mem_takeConcat
statement:
theorem mem_takeConcat (S : TriangularSet σ R) {p : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : p ≠ 0) :
    p ∈ S.takeConcat p
proof:
:= by
  unfold takeConcat
  split_ifs with _ hc
  repeat' exact mem_single_of_ne_zero h
  exact mem_concat _

name: takeConcat_subset
statement: theorem takeConcat_subset : ∀ q ∈ S.takeConcat p, q ≠ p → q ∈ S
proof:
:= fun q hq1 hq2 ↦ by
  unfold takeConcat at hq1
  split_ifs at hq1 with hs hc
  repeat exact absurd hq1 <| notMem_single_of_ne hq2
  let k := Nat.find <| exists_index_max_vars_between_of_max_vars_first_lt <| lt_of_not_ge hc
  apply S.take_subset k
  change q ∈ ((S.take k).concat p _ : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)) at hq1
  simpa [coe_concat_eq_insert, Set.insert, hq2] using hq1

name: isAscendingSet_def
statement:
theorem isAscendingSet_def : StandardAscendingSet.IsAscendingSet S ↔
    ∀ ⦃i j⦄, i < j → j < S.length → (S j).reducedTo (S i)
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: isAscendingSet_def'
statement:
theorem isAscendingSet_def' : StandardAscendingSet.IsAscendingSet S ↔
    ∀ ⦃i j⦄, i < j → i < S.length → (S j).reducedTo (S i)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h i j hij hi ↦ ?_, fun h _ _ hij hj ↦ h hij (lt_trans hij hj)⟩
  by_cases hj : j < S.length
  · exact h hij hj
  rw [eq_zero_iff_length_le.mp <| Nat.le_of_not_lt hj]
  exact zero_reducedTo _

name: reducedTo_of_ne
statement:
theorem reducedTo_of_ne {i j : ℕ} (h : StandardAscendingSet.IsAscendingSet S) :
    i ≠ j → j < S.length → (S i).reducedTo (S j)
proof:
:= fun hij hj ↦
  match lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with
  | .inl hij => reducedTo_of_max_vars_lt <| max_vars_lt_of_index_lt hj hij
  | .inr hij => (isAscendingSet_def'.mp h) hij hj

name: isAscendingSet_concat
statement:
theorem isAscendingSet_concat (h : S.CanConcat p) (hp : p.reducedToSet S) :
    S.IsAscendingSet → (S.concat p).IsAscendingSet
proof:
:=
  TriangularSet.isAscendingSet_concat h (reducedToSet_iff.mp hp)

name: isAscendingSet_takeConcat
statement:
theorem isAscendingSet_takeConcat (hp : p.reducedToSet S) :
    S.IsAscendingSet → (S.takeConcat p).IsAscendingSet
proof:
:=
  TriangularSet.isAscendingSet_takeConcat (reducedToSet_iff.mp hp)

name: basicSetGo_lt
statement:
lemma basicSetGo_lt (l : List (MvPolynomial σ R)) (BS : TriangularSet σ R)
    (hl1 : ∀ p ∈ l, p ≠ 0) (h : l ≠ []) (hl2 : (l.head h).reducedToSet BS) :
    basicSet.go l BS hl1 < BS
proof:
:= by
  induction l, BS, hl1 using basicSet.go.induct with
  | case1 => simp at h
  | case2 BS B tail hl1 BS' l' _ ih =>
    rw [basicSet.go]
    change basicSet.go l' BS' _ < BS
    have : BS' < BS := takeConcat_lt_of_reducedToSet (hl1 _ <| List.head_mem h) hl2
    by_cases h' : l' = []
    · rw! [h', basicSet.go]
      exact this
    · exact lt_trans (ih h' <| of_decide_eq_true (List.mem_filter.mp <| List.head_mem h').2) this

name: basicSetGo_le
statement:
lemma basicSetGo_le (l : List (MvPolynomial σ R)) (BS : TriangularSet σ R)
    (hl1 : ∀ p ∈ l, p ≠ 0) (hl2 : l.head?.all (fun p ↦ p.reducedToSet BS)) :
    basicSet.go l BS hl1 ≤ BS
proof:
:= by
  induction l, BS, hl1 using basicSet.go.induct with
  | case1 => simp [basicSet.go]
  | case2 BS B tail hl1 _ _ _ =>
    rw [List.head?_cons, Option.all_some, decide_eq_true_eq] at hl2
    exact le_of_lt <| basicSetGo_lt (B :: tail) BS hl1 (by simp) hl2

name: mem_of_mem_basicSetGo
statement:
lemma mem_of_mem_basicSetGo (l : List (MvPolynomial σ R)) (BS : TriangularSet σ R)
    (hl1 : ∀ p ∈ l, p ≠ 0) : ∀ p, p ∉ BS → p ∈ basicSet.go l BS hl1 → p ∈ l
proof:
:= by
  induction l, BS, hl1 using basicSet.go.induct with
  | case1 => simp only [basicSet.go, List.not_mem_nil, imp_false, imp_self, implies_true]
  | case2 BS B tail hl1 BS' l' h ih =>
      intro p hp1 hp2
      rw [basicSet.go] at hp2
      change p ∈ basicSet.go l' BS' _ at hp2
      have hnotMem : p = B ∨ p ∉ BS' :=
        or_not_of_imp fun h ↦ not_not.mp <| ne_eq _ _ ▸ (mt <| takeConcat_subset p h) hp1
      match hnotMem with
      | .inl hm => exact List.mem_cons.mpr <| Or.inl hm
      | .inr hm => exact List.mem_of_mem_filter <| ih p hm hp2

name: basicSetGo_isAscendingSet
statement:
lemma basicSetGo_isAscendingSet (l : List (MvPolynomial σ R)) (BS : TriangularSet σ R)
    (hl1 : ∀ p ∈ l, p ≠ 0) : l.head?.all (fun p ↦ p.reducedToSet BS) → BS.IsAscendingSet →
    (basicSet.go l BS hl1).IsAscendingSet
proof:
:= by
  induction l, BS, hl1 using basicSet.go.induct with
  | case1 => unfold basicSet.go; simp
  | case2 BS B tail hl1 BS' l' h ih =>
      intro hBS1 hBS2
      rw [basicSet.go]
      rw [List.head?_cons, Option.all_some, decide_eq_true_eq] at hBS1
      refine ih ?_ <| isAscendingSet_takeConcat hBS1 hBS2
      if l'_nil : l' = [] then simp [l'_nil]
      else
        simp only [List.head?_eq_some_head l'_nil, Option.all_some, decide_eq_true_eq]
        exact of_decide_eq_true (List.mem_filter.mp <| List.head_mem l'_nil).2

name: basicSetGo_le_ascendingSet
statement:
lemma basicSetGo_le_ascendingSet (l : List (MvPolynomial σ R)) (BS : TriangularSet σ R)
    (hl1 : ∀ p ∈ l, p ≠ 0) : l.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) → (∀ p ∈ l, BS.CanConcat p) →
    l.head?.all (reducedToSet · BS) →
    ∀ T, T.IsAscendingSet → (BS.length ≤ T.length ∧ ∀ i < BS.length, BS i ≈ T i) →
    (∀ p ∈ T, (∀ i < BS.length, ¬ BS i ≈ p) → p ∈ l) → basicSet.go l BS hl1 ≤ T
proof:
:= by
  induction l, BS, hl1 using basicSet.go.induct with
  | case1 BS hl1 =>
    intro _ _ _ T _ _ hT4
    rw [basicSet.go]
    refine ge_of_forall_equiv fun n hn ↦ ?_
    simpa using hT4 _ (apply_mem hn)
  | case2 BS B tail hl1 BS' l' _ ih =>
    intro hl2 hBS1 hBS2 T hT1 ⟨hT2, hT3⟩ hT4
    have hB1 := hBS1 B List.mem_cons_self
    have hB2 : ∀ ⦃q⦄, q ∈ B :: tail → B ≤ q := fun _ ↦ List.Pairwise.rel_head hl2
    rw [List.head?_cons, Option.all_some, decide_eq_true_eq] at hBS2
    have heq : BS' = BS.concat B := takeConcat_eq_concat_of_canConcat hB1
    by_cases hL : T.length = BS.length
    · have : BS ≈ T := equiv_iff'.mpr ⟨hL.symm, hT3⟩
      refine le_of_lt <| TriangularSet.lt_of_lt_of_equiv ?_ this
      exact basicSetGo_lt (B :: tail) BS hl1 (by simp) hBS2
    have hL : BS.length < T.length := Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne hT2 (Ne.symm hL)
    rw [basicSet.go]
    change basicSet.go l' BS' _ ≤ T
    let q := T BS.length
    have Bleq : B ≤ q := by
      refine hB2 <| (hT4 q <| apply_mem hL) fun i hi ↦ ?_
      apply not_antisymmRel_of_lt
      rw [AntisymmRel.lt_congr_left <| hT3 i hi]
      exact apply_lt_of_index_lt hL hi
    have hBS2' : l'.head?.all (reducedToSet · BS') := by
      simp only [Option.all_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
      intro r hr
      have : r ∈ l' := List.mem_of_mem_head? hr
      exact of_decide_eq_true (List.mem_filter.mp this).2
    
    rcases  le_iff_lt_or_equiv.mp Bleq with Bltq | hBq
    · 
      have : BS' < T := by
        rw [heq]
        apply TriangularSet.lt_def.mpr
        refine Or.inl ⟨BS.length, BS.length_concat _ ▸ lt_add_one _, ?_, fun i hi ↦ ?_⟩
        · simpa [concat_apply] using Bltq
        rw [concat_apply, if_pos hi]
        exact hT3 i hi
      refine le_trans ?_ (le_of_lt this)
      exact basicSetGo_le _ _ _ hBS2'
    
    have hBS1' : ∀ p ∈ l', BS'.CanConcat p := fun p hp ↦ by
      simp only [l', heq, List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq, reducedToSet_iff] at hp ⊢
      refine ⟨hl1 p hp.1, fun _ ↦ ?_⟩
      have := hp.2 BS.length (BS.length_concat _ ▸ lt_add_one _)
      simp only [concat_apply, lt_self_iff_false, ↓reduceIte, length_concat,
        add_tsub_cancel_right, gt_iff_lt] at this ⊢
      exact max_vars_lt_of_reducedTo_of_le (hl1 p hp.1) (hB2 hp.1) this
    refine ih (List.Pairwise.filter _ hl2) hBS1' hBS2' T hT1 ⟨?_, fun i hi ↦ ?_⟩ ?_
    · rw [heq, BS.length_concat]
      exact hL
    · simp only [heq, length_concat, concat_apply] at hi ⊢
      split_ifs with hi1 hi2
      · exact hT3 i hi1
      · exact hi2 ▸ hBq
      absurd hi1
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hi) hi2
    intro p hp1 hp2
    simp only [l', List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq, heq] at hp2 ⊢
    have hp2 : ¬ B ≈ p ∧ ∀ i < BS.length, ¬ BS i ≈ p := by
      simp only [length_concat, concat_apply] at hp2
      constructor
      · simpa using hp2 BS.length (lt_add_one _)
      intro i hi
      simpa [hi] using hp2 i (Nat.lt_add_right 1 hi)
    refine ⟨hT4 p hp1 hp2.2, reducedToSet_iff.mpr fun i hi ↦ ?_⟩
    rcases hp1 with ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩
    have hk3 : BS.length < k := by
      contrapose! hp2
      refine fun hp3 ↦ ⟨k, ?_⟩
      have : k ≠ BS.length := fun this ↦ absurd hp3 (by rw [not_not, ← hk2, this]; exact hBq)
      have : k < BS.length := lt_of_le_of_ne hp2 this
      exact ⟨this, hk2 ▸ hT3 k this⟩
    rw [← hk2, concat_apply]
    split_ifs with hi1 hi2
    · exact (reducedTo_congr_right <| hT3 i hi1).mpr <| hT1 (lt_trans hi1 hk3) hk1
    · exact (reducedTo_congr_right hBq).mpr <| hT1 hk3 hk1
    absurd hi1
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (Nat.le_of_lt_add_one (BS.length_concat _ ▸ hi)) hi2

name: basicSet_isAscendingSet
statement: protected lemma basicSet_isAscendingSet : (basicSet l).IsAscendingSet
proof:
:=
  basicSetGo_isAscendingSet _ _ _ Option.all_true isAscendingSet_empty

name: basicSet_subset
statement: protected lemma basicSet_subset : ∀ ⦃p : MvPolynomial σ R⦄, p ∈ basicSet l → p ∈ l
proof:
:= fun p hp ↦
  List.mem_mergeSort.mp <|
    List.mem_of_mem_filter (mem_of_mem_basicSetGo _ ∅ _ p (notMem_empty p) hp)

name: basicSet_minimal
statement:
protected lemma basicSet_minimal : ∀ ⦃S : TriangularSet σ R⦄, S.IsAscendingSet →
    (∀ ⦃p⦄, p ∈ S → p ∈ l) → basicSet l ≤ S
proof:
:= fun S hS1 hS2 ↦ by
  let sl := l.mergeSort.filter (· ≠ 0)
  have hsl1 : ∀ p ∈ sl, p ≠ 0 := fun _ hp ↦ of_decide_eq_true (List.mem_filter.mp hp).2
  have hsl2 : sl.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) := List.Pairwise.filter _ <| l.pairwise_mergeSort' (· ≤ ·)
  refine basicSetGo_le_ascendingSet _ ∅ hsl1 hsl2 (fun q hq ↦ empty_canConcat (hsl1 q hq))
      Option.all_true S hS1 (by simp) (fun p hp1 _ ↦ List.mem_filter.mpr ?_)
  exact ⟨List.mem_mergeSort.mpr (hS2 hp1), decide_eq_true <| ne_zero_of_mem hp1⟩

name: mainDegree_of_max_vars_isSome
statement: theorem mainDegree_of_max_vars_isSome : p.vars.max = c → p.mainDegree = p.degreeOf c
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ by rw [mainDegree, h]

name: mainDegree_of_max_vars_isSome'
statement:
theorem mainDegree_of_max_vars_isSome' :
    p.vars.max = c → p.mainDegree = p.support.sup (fun s ↦ s c)
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ by rw [mainDegree_of_max_vars_isSome h, degreeOf_eq_sup]

name: mainDegree_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem mainDegree_eq_zero_iff : p.mainDegree = 0 ↔ p.vars.max = ⊥ where
  mp h
proof:
:=
    match hc : p.vars.max with
    | ⊥ => rfl
    | some c => by
      rw [mainDegree_of_max_vars_isSome hc, degreeOf] at h
      have : c ∉ p.degrees := by simpa only [Multiset.count_eq_zero] using h
      have hc := Finset.mem_of_max hc
      simp only [vars_def, Multiset.mem_toFinset] at hc
      exact absurd hc this
  mpr h := by rw [mainDegree, h]

name: mainDegree_eq_zero_iff_eq_C
statement: theorem mainDegree_eq_zero_iff_eq_C : p.mainDegree = 0 ↔ p = C (p.coeff 0)
proof:
:=
  mainDegree_eq_zero_iff.trans <| Finset.max_eq_bot.trans vars_eq_empty_iff_eq_C

name: degreeOf_max_vars_ne_zero
statement: theorem degreeOf_max_vars_ne_zero : p.vars.max = c → p.degreeOf c ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  have := (not_iff_not.mpr mainDegree_eq_zero_iff).mpr (h ▸ WithBot.coe_ne_bot)
  mainDegree_of_max_vars_isSome h ▸ this

name: max_vars_mem_degrees
statement: theorem max_vars_mem_degrees : p.vars.max = c → c ∈ p.degrees
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  have := degreeOf_max_vars_ne_zero h; Multiset.count_ne_zero.mp (degreeOf_def c p ▸ this)

name: mainDegree_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem mainDegree_zero : (0 : MvPolynomial σ R).mainDegree = 0
proof: := rfl

name: mainDegree_monomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem mainDegree_monomial {s : σ →₀ ℕ} {r : R} (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (hs : s.support.max = c) : (monomial s r).mainDegree = s c
proof:
:= by
  rw [mainDegree_of_max_vars_isSome <| (congrArg _ (vars_monomial hr)).trans hs]
  exact degreeOf_monomial_eq s c hr

name: mainDegree_C
statement: @[simp] theorem mainDegree_C (r : R) : (C r : MvPolynomial σ R).mainDegree = 0
proof:
:=
  mainDegree_eq_zero_iff.mpr <| congrArg _ (vars_C)

name: mainDegree_X_pow
statement:
@[simp] theorem mainDegree_X_pow [Nontrivial R] (i : σ) (k : ℕ) :
    ((X i : MvPolynomial σ R) ^ k).mainDegree = k
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · exact hk ▸ pow_zero (X i : MvPolynomial σ R) ▸ mainDegree_C 1
  have : (Finsupp.single i k).support.max = i := by rw [Finsupp.support_single_ne_zero i hk]; rfl
  rw [X_pow_eq_monomial, mainDegree_monomial one_ne_zero this, Finsupp.single_eq_same]

statement: @[simp] theorem mainDegree_X [Nontrivial R] (i : σ) : (X i : MvPolynomial σ R).mainDegree = 1
proof:
:=
  pow_one (X i : MvPolynomial σ R) ▸ mainDegree_X_pow i 1

name: lCS_non_zero
statement: lemma lCS_non_zero : 0 ∉ lCS
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lCS, p₅, Fin.isValue, p₆, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false, not_or]
  decide +kernel

name: foldrIdx_mul_eq_prod
statement:
lemma foldrIdx_mul_eq_prod {σ R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [LinearOrder σ] (es : List ℕ)
    (S : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R) :
    es.foldrIdx (fun i e I ↦ (S i) ^ e * I) 1  = ∏ i : Fin es.length, (S i) ^ es[i]
proof:
:= by
  have (es : List ℕ) (S : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R) : es.foldrIdx (fun i e I ↦ (S i) ^ e * I) 1
      = (∏ i ∈ Finset.range es.length, (S i) ^ es.getD i 0) := by
    induction es generalizing S with
    | nil => simp
    | cons e es ih =>
      simp only [List.foldrIdx, zero_add, List.length_cons]
      rewrite [List.foldrIdx_start, ih, add_comm _ 1, Finset.prod_range_add, Finset.prod_range_one]
      simp [add_comm]
  simp [this, Finset.prod_range]

name: foldrIdx_add_eq_sum
statement:
lemma foldrIdx_add_eq_sum {σ R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [LinearOrder σ]
    (qs : List (MvPolynomial σ R)) (S : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R) :
    qs.foldrIdx (fun i q Q ↦ q * S i + Q) 0  = ∑ i : Fin qs.length, qs[i] * S i
proof:
:= by
  have (qs : List _) (S : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R) : qs.foldrIdx (fun i q Q ↦ q * S i + Q) 0
      = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range qs.length, qs.getD i 0 * S i) := by
    induction qs generalizing S with
    | nil => simp
    | cons q qs ih =>
      simp only [List.foldrIdx, zero_add, List.length_cons]
      rewrite [List.foldrIdx_start, ih, add_comm _ 1, Finset.sum_range_add, Finset.sum_range_one]
      simp [add_comm]
  simp [this, Finset.sum_range]

name: vanishingSet_singleton_eq_vanishingSet'
statement:
theorem vanishingSet_singleton_eq_vanishingSet' :
    vanishingSet K ({p} : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)) = vanishingSet' K p
proof:
:= by

name: vanishingSet_eq_zeroLocus_span
statement: theorem vanishingSet_eq_zeroLocus_span : vanishingSet K PS = zeroLocus K (Ideal.span PS)

:=
  (zeroLocus_span PS).symm

theorem vanishingSet_eq_zeroLocus_span' {α : Type*} [Membership (MvPolynomial σ R) α] (a : α) :
    vanishingSet K a = zeroLocus K (Ideal.span {p | p ∈ a})
